verses.sa:
ओ चित्सखायं सख्या ववृत्यां तिरः पुरू चिदर्णवं जगन्वान् ।
पितुर्नपातमा दधीत वेधा अधि क्षमि प्रतरं दीध्यानः ॥
verses.rom:
o chitsakhayam sakhya vavrityam tirah puru chidarnavam jaganvan |
piturnapatama dadhita vedha adhi kshami prataram didhyanah ||
verses.en: Unto a friend would I turn with friendship; having gone through much ocean, may the pious one take a grandson of [his] father, considering further onward upon the earth (kṣám).

verses.sa:
न ते सखा सख्यं वष्ट्येतत्सलक्ष्मा यद्विषुरूपा भवति ।
महस्पुत्रासो असुरस्य वीरा दिवो धर्तार उर्विया परि ख्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
na te sakha sakhyam vashtyetatsalakshma yadvishurupa bhavati |
mahasputraso asurasya vira divo dhartara urviya pari khyan ||
verses.en: Thy friend wants (vaç) not that friendship of thine, that she of like sign should become of diverse form; the sons of the great Asura, heroes, sustainers of the sky (dív), look widely about.

verses.sa:
उशन्ति घा ते अमृतास एतदेकस्य चित्त्यजसं मर्त्यस्य ।
नि ते मनो मनसि धाय्यस्मे जन्युः पतिस्तन्वमा विविष्याः ॥
verses.rom:
ushanti gha te amritasa etadekasya chittyajasam martyasya |
ni te mano manasi dhayyasme janyuh patistanvama vivishyah ||
verses.en: Truly those immortals want that—posterity (? tyajás) of the one mortal; may thy mind be set in our mind; mayest thou enter [as] husband a wife's body.

verses.sa:
न यत्पुरा चकृमा कद्ध नूनमृतं वदन्तो अनृतं रपेम ।
गन्धर्वो अप्स्वप्या च योषा सा नौ नाभिः परमं जामि तन् नौ ॥
verses.rom:
na yatpura chakrima kaddha nunamritam vadanto anritam rapema |
gandharvo apsvapya cha yosha sa nau nabhih paramam jami tan nau ||
verses.en: What we (pl.) did not do formerly, why [do that] now? speaking righteousness, should we prate unrighteousness? The Gandharva in the waters and the watery woman (yóṣā)—that is our (du.) union (nā́bhi), that our du. highest relation (jāmí).

verses.sa:
गर्भे नु नौ जनिता दम्पती कर्देवस्त्वष्टा सविता विश्वरूपः ।
नकिरस्य प्र मिनन्ति व्रतानि वेद नावस्य पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
garbhe nu nau janita dampati kardevastvashta savita vishvarupah |
nakirasya pra minanti vratani veda navasya prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en: Verily, the generator made us (du.) in the womb man and spouse—god Tvashṭar, Savitar of all forms; none overthrow (pra-mī) his ordinances (vratá); earth knows us two as such, also heaven.

verses.sa:
को अद्य युङ्क्ते धुरि गा ऋतस्य शिमीवतो भामिनो दुर्हृणायून् ।
आसन्निषून् हृत्स्वसो मयोभून् य एषां भृत्यामृणधत्स जीवात् ॥
verses.rom:
ko adya yunkte dhuri ga ritasya shimivato bhamino durhrinayun |
asannishun hritsvaso mayobhun ya esham bhrityamrinadhatsa jivat ||
verses.en: Who yokes to the pole today the kine of righteousness, the diligent, the bright, the slow to wrath (? durhṛṇāyú), that have arrows in the mouth, that shoot at the heart, amiable ones? whoso shall prosper their burden, he shall live.

verses.sa:
को अस्य वेद प्रथमस्याह्नः क ईं ददर्श क इह प्र वोचत्।
बृहन् मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम कदु ब्रव आहनो वीच्या नॄन् ॥
verses.rom:
ko asya veda prathamasyahnah ka im dadarsha ka iha pra vochat|
brihan mitrasya varunasya dhama kadu brava ahano vichya nrin ||
verses.en: Who knows of that first day? who saw it? who shall proclaim it here? Great is the ordinance (dhā́man) of Mitra, of Varuṇa; why, O lustful one, wilt thou speak to men with deceit (? vī́ci)?

verses.sa:
यमस्य मा यम्यं काम आगन्त्समाने योनौ सहशेय्याय ।
जायेव पत्ये तन्वं रिरिच्यां वि चिद्वृहेव रथ्येव चक्रा ॥
verses.rom:
yamasya ma yamyam kama agantsamane yonau sahasheyyaya |
jayeva patye tanvam ririchyam vi chidvriheva rathyeva chakra ||
verses.en: Desire of Yama hath come unto me Yamī, in order to lying together in the same lair (yóni); I would fain yield (ric) my body, as wife to husband; may we whirl off, like two chariot wheels.

verses.sa:
न तिष्ठन्ति न नि मिषन्त्येते देवानां स्पश इह ये चरन्ति ।
अन्येन मदाहनो याहि तूयं तेन वि वृह रथ्येव चक्रा ॥
verses.rom:
na tishthanti na ni mishantyete devanam spasha iha ye charanti |
anyena madahano yahi tuyam tena vi vriha rathyeva chakra ||
verses.en: They stand not, they wink not, those spies of the gods who go about here; with another than me, O lustful one, go quickly; with him whirl off like two chariot wheels.

verses.sa:
रात्रीभिरस्मा अहभिर्दशस्येत्सूर्यस्य चक्षुर्मुहुरुन् मिमीयात्।
दिवा पृथिव्या मिथुना सबन्धू यमीर्यमस्य विवृहादजामि ॥
verses.rom:
ratribhirasma ahabhirdashasyetsuryasya chakshurmuhurun mimiyat|
diva prithivya mithuna sabandhu yamiryamasya vivrihadajami ||
verses.en: By nights, by days one may pay reverence (daçasy) to him; the sun's eye may open (? ún mimīyāt) for a moment; with heaven, with earth paired, of near connection;—Yamī must bear the unbrotherly (ájāmi) [conduct] of Yama.

verses.sa:
आ घा ता गच्छान् उत्तरा युगानि यत्र जामयः कृणवन्न् अजामि ।
उप बर्बृहि वृषभाय बाहुमन्यमिच्छस्व सुभगे पतिं मत् ॥
verses.rom:
a gha ta gachchhan uttara yugani yatra jamayah krinavann ajami |
upa barbrihi vrishabhaya bahumanyamichchhasva subhage patim mat ||
verses.en: Verily there shall come those later ages (yugá) in which next of kin (jāmí) shall do what is unkinly ájāmi. Put thine arm underneath a hero (vṛṣabhá); seek, O fortunate one, another husband than me.

verses.sa:
किं भ्रातासद्यदनाथं भवाति किमु स्वसा यन् निर्ऋतिर्निगछात्।
काममूता बह्वेतद्रपामि तन्वा मे तन्वं सं पिपृग्धि ॥
verses.rom:
kim bhratasadyadanatham bhavati kimu svasa yan nirritirnigachhat|
kamamuta bahvetadrapami tanva me tanvam sam piprigdhi ||
verses.en: What should brother be when there is no protector? or what sister, when destruction impends (ni-gam)? Impelled by desire, I prate thus much; mingle thou thy body with my body.

verses.sa:
न ते नाथं यम्यत्राहमस्मि न ते तनूं तन्वा सं पपृच्याम् ।
अन्येन मत्प्रमुदः कल्पयस्व न ते भ्राता सुभगे वष्ट्येतत् ॥
verses.rom:
na te natham yamyatrahamasmi na te tanum tanva sam paprichyam |
anyena matpramudah kalpayasva na te bhrata subhage vashtyetat ||
verses.en: I am not thy protector here, O Yamī; I may not mingle my body with thy body; with another than me do thou prepare enjoyments; thy brother wants not that, O fortunate one.

verses.sa:
न वा उ ते तनूं तन्वा सं पिपृच्यां पापमाहुर्यः स्वसारं निगच्छात्।
असंयदेतन् मनसो हृदो मे भ्राता स्वसुः शयने यच्छयीय ॥
verses.rom:
na va u te tanum tanva sam piprichyam papamahuryah svasaram nigachchhat|
asamyadetan manaso hrido me bhrata svasuh shayane yachchhayiya ||
verses.en: Verily, I may not mingle my body with thy body; they call him wicked (pāpá) who should approach his sister. That is not consonant (? asaṁyát) with my mind [and] heart, that I, a brother, should lie in a sister's bed (çáyana).

verses.sa:
बतो बतासि यम नैव ते मनो हृदयं चाविदामा ।
अन्या किल त्वां कक्ष्येव युक्तं परि ष्वजातौ लिबुजेव वृक्षम् ॥
verses.rom:
bato batasi yama naiva te mano hridayam chavidama |
anya kila tvam kakshyeva yuktam pari shvajatau libujeva vriksham ||
verses.en: A weakling (? batá), alas, art thou, O Yama; we have not found mind and heart thine; verily, another woman shall embrace thee, as a girth a harnessed [horse], as a twining plant (líbujā) a tree.

verses.sa:
अन्यमू षु यम्यन्य उ त्वां परि ष्वजातौ लिबुजेव वृक्षम् ।
तस्य वा त्वं मन इछा स वा तवाधा कृणुष्व संविदं सुभद्राम् ॥
verses.rom:
anyamu shu yamyanya u tvam pari shvajatau libujeva vriksham |
tasya va tvam mana ichha sa va tavadha krinushva samvidam subhadram ||
verses.en: Another man, truly, O Yamī, another man shall embrace thee, as a twining plant a tree; either do thou seek his mind or he thine; then make for thyself very excellent concord (samvíd).

verses.sa:
त्रीणि च्छन्दांसि कवयो वि येतिरे पुरुरूपं दर्शतं विश्वचक्षणम् ।
आपो वाता ओषधयस्तान्येकस्मिन् भुवन आर्पितानि ॥
verses.rom:
trini chchhandamsi kavayo vi yetire pururupam darshatam vishvachakshanam |
apo vata oshadhayastanyekasmin bhuvana arpitani ||
verses.en: Three meters the poets extended (? vi-yat)—the many-formed one, the admirable, the all-beholding; waters, winds, herbs—these are set (ā́rpita) in one being (bhúvana).

verses.sa:
वृषा वृष्णे दुदुहे दोहसा दिवः पयांसि यह्वो अदितेरदाभ्यः ।
विश्वं स वेद वरुणो यथा धिया स यज्ञियो यजति यज्ञियामृतून् ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha vrishne duduhe dohasa divah payamsi yahvo aditeradabhyah |
vishvam sa veda varuno yatha dhiya sa yajniyo yajati yajniyamritun ||
verses.en: The bull yieldeth (duh) milks for the bull with the milking of the sky (dív), he the unharmable son (? yahvá) of Aditi; everything knoweth he, like Varuṇa, by thought (dhī́); he, sharing the sacrifice (yajñíya), sacrificeth to the seasons that share the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
रपद्गन्धर्वीरप्या च योषणा नदस्य नादे परि पातु नो मनः ।
इष्टस्य मध्ये अदितिर्नि धातु नो भ्राता नो ज्येष्ठः प्रथमो वि वोचति ॥
verses.rom:
rapadgandharvirapya cha yoshana nadasya nade pari patu no manah |
ishtasya madhye aditirni dhatu no bhrata no jyeshthah prathamo vi vochati ||
verses.en: Prateth the Gandharvī and watery woman; in the noise of the noisy one (nadá) let [her] protect our mind; let Aditi set us in the midst of what is desired (? iṣṭá); our oldest brother shall first speak out.

verses.sa:
सो चित्नु भद्रा क्षुमती यशस्वत्युषा उवास मनवे स्वर्वती ।
यदीमुशन्तमुशतामनु क्रतुमग्निं होतारं विदथाय जीजनन् ॥
verses.rom:
so chitnu bhadra kshumati yashasvatyusha uvasa manave svarvati |
yadimushantamushatamanu kratumagnim hotaram vidathaya jijanan ||
verses.en: She now, the excellent, rich in food, full of glory—the dawn hath shone for man (mánu), full of light (svàr-); since they have generated for the council [as] hótṛ Agni, the eager one, after the will (krátu) of the eager ones.

verses.sa:
अध त्यं द्रप्सं विभ्वं विचक्षनं विराभरदिषिरः श्येनो अध्वरे ।
यदी विशो वृणते दस्ममार्या अग्निं होतारमध धीरजायत ॥
verses.rom:
adha tyam drapsam vibhvam vichakshanam virabharadishirah shyeno adhvare |
yadi visho vrinate dasmamarya agnim hotaramadha dhirajayata ||
verses.en: Then that mighty (vibhū́) conspicuous drop did the bird, the lively falcon, bring at the sacrifice; if the Aryan tribes (víç) choose the wondrous one, Agni, [as] hótṛ, then prayer (dhī́) was born.

verses.sa:
सदासि रण्वो यवसेव पुष्यते होत्राभिरग्ने मनुषः स्वध्वरः ।
विप्रस्य वा यच्छशमान उक्थ्यो वाजं ससवामुपयासि भूरिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sadasi ranvo yavaseva pushyate hotrabhiragne manushah svadhvarah |
viprasya va yachchhashamana ukthyo vajam sasavamupayasi bhuribhih ||
verses.en: Ever art thou pleasant (raṇvá), as pastures to him that enjoys (puṣ) them, being, O Agni, well sacrificed to with the offerings of man (mánus); or when, active, praiseworthy, having won the strength (vā́ja) of the inspired one (vípra), thou approachest with very many.

verses.sa:
उदीरय पितरा जार आ भगमियक्षति हर्यतो हृत्त इष्यति ।
विवक्ति वह्निः स्वपस्यते मखस्तविष्यते असुरो वेपते मती ॥
verses.rom:
udiraya pitara jara a bhagamiyakshati haryato hritta ishyati |
vivakti vahnih svapasyate makhastavishyate asuro vepate mati ||
verses.en: Send thou up the (two) fathers, [as] a lover, unto enjoyment (bhága). The welcome one (haryatá) desires to sacrifice; he sends from the heart; the bearer (váhni) speaks out; the merry one (? makhá) does a good work; the Asura shows might (taviṣy); he trembles with purpose (? matī́).

verses.sa:
यस्ते अग्ने सुमतिं मर्तो अख्यत्सहसः सूनो अति स प्र शृण्वे ।
इषं दधानो वहमानो अश्वैरा स द्युमाममवान् भूषति द्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
yaste agne sumatim marto akhyatsahasah suno ati sa pra shrinve |
isham dadhano vahamano ashvaira sa dyumamamavan bhushati dyun ||
verses.en: Whatever mortal hath seen thy favor, O Agni, son of power, he is renowned exceedingly; acquiring (dhā) food (íṣ), borne by horses, he, lightful, vigorous, passes (? ā-bhūṣ) the days (dív).

verses.sa:
श्रुधी नो अग्ने सदने सधस्थे युक्ष्वा रथममृतस्य द्रवित्नुम् ।
आ नो वह रोदसी देवपुत्रे माकिर्देवानामप भूरिह स्याः ॥
verses.rom:
shrudhi no agne sadane sadhasthe yukshva rathamamritasya dravitnum |
a no vaha rodasi devaputre makirdevanamapa bhuriha syah ||
verses.en: Hear us, O Agni, in thy seat, thy station; harness the speedy chariot of the immortal (amṛ́ta); bring to us the two firmaments (ródasī), parents of the gods; be thou of the gods never (mā́kis) away; mayest thou be here.

verses.sa:
यदग्न एषा समितिर्भवाति देवी देवेषु यजता यजत्र ।
रत्ना च यद्विभजासि स्वधावो भागं नो अत्र वसुमन्तं वीतात् ॥
verses.rom:
yadagna esha samitirbhavati devi deveshu yajata yajatra |
ratna cha yadvibhajasi svadhavo bhagam no atra vasumantam vitat ||
verses.en: That, O Agni, this meeting may take place (bhū), divine, among the gods, worshipful, thou reverend one, and that thou mayest share out treasures, O self-ruling one, do thou enjoy here our portion filled with good things.

verses.sa:
अन्वग्निरुषसामग्रमख्यदन्वहानि प्रथमो जातवेदाः ।
अनु सूर्य उषसो अनु रश्मीन् द्यावापृथिवी आ विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
anvagnirushasamagramakhyadanvahani prathamo jatavedah |
anu surya ushaso anu rashmin dyavaprithivi a vivesha ||
verses.en: Agni hath looked after the apex of the dawns, after the days, [he] first, Jātavedas; a sun, after the dawns, after the rays; after heaven-and-earth he entered.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यग्निरुषसामग्रमख्यत्प्रत्यहानि प्रथमो जातवेदाः ।
प्रति सूर्यस्य पुरुधा च रश्मीन् प्रति द्यावापृथिवी आ ततान ॥
verses.rom:
pratyagnirushasamagramakhyatpratyahani prathamo jatavedah |
prati suryasya purudha cha rashmin prati dyavaprithivi a tatana ||
verses.en: Agni hath looked forth to meet the apex of the dawns, to meet the days, [he] first, Jātavedas, and to meet the rays of the sun in many places; to meet heaven-and-earth he stretched out.

verses.sa:
द्यावा ह क्षामा प्रथमे ऋतेनाभिश्रावे भवतः सत्यवाचा ।
देवो यन् मर्तान् यजथाय कृण्वन्त्सीदद्धोता प्रत्यङ्स्वमसुं यन् ॥
verses.rom:
dyava ha kshama prathame ritenabhishrave bhavatah satyavacha |
devo yan martan yajathaya krinvantsidaddhota pratyansvamasum yan ||
verses.en: Heaven and earth, first by right, truth-speaking, are within hearing, when the god, making mortals to sacrifice, sits as hótṛ, going to meet his own being (ásu).

verses.sa:
देवो देवान् परिभूर्ऋतेन वहा नो हव्यं प्रथमश्चिकित्वान् ।
धूमकेतुः समिधा भाऋजीको मन्द्रो होता नित्यो वाचा यजीयान् ॥
verses.rom:
devo devan paribhurritena vaha no havyam prathamashchikitvan |
dhumaketuh samidha bharijiko mandro hota nityo vacha yajiyan ||
verses.en: A god, encompassing the gods with right, carry thou first our offering, understanding [it]; smoke-bannered by the fuel, light-beaming, a pleasant, constant hótṛ, skilled sacrificer with speech.

verses.sa:
अर्चामि वां वर्धायापो घृतस्नू द्यावाभूमी शृणुतं रोदसी मे ।
अहा यद्देवा असुनीतिमायन् मध्वा नो अत्र पितरा शिशीताम् ॥
verses.rom:
archami vam vardhayapo ghritasnu dyavabhumi shrinutam rodasi me |
aha yaddeva asunitimayan madhva no atra pitara shishitam ||
verses.en: I praise (arc) your (du.) work unto increase, ye ghee-surfaced ones; O heaven-and-earth, hear me, ye two firmaments (ródasī); when days, O gods, went to the other life (ásunīti), let the two parents (pitárā) sharpen us here with honey.

verses.sa:
स्वावृग्देवस्यामृतं यदी गोरतो जातासो धारयन्त उर्वी ।
विश्वे देवा अनु तत्ते यजुर्गुर्दुहे यदेनी दिव्यं घृतं वाः ॥
verses.rom:
svavrigdevasyamritam yadi gorato jataso dharayanta urvi |
vishve deva anu tatte yajurgurduhe yadeni divyam ghritam vah ||
verses.en: If the god's immortality (amṛ́ta) is easy to appropriate for the cow, thence those who are born maintain themselves on the broad [earth]; all the gods go after that sacrificial formula of thine, when the hind yields (duh) the ghee, heavenly liquor (vā́r).

verses.sa:
किं स्विन् नो राजा जगृहे कदस्याति व्रतं चकृमा को वि वेद ।
मित्रस्चिद्धि ष्मा जुहुराणो देवां छ्लोको न यातामपि वाजो अस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
kim svin no raja jagrihe kadasyati vratam chakrima ko vi veda |
mitraschiddhi shma juhurano devam chhloko na yatamapi vajo asti ||
verses.en: Why forsooth hath the king seized (grah) us? what have we done in transgression of (áti) his ordinance (vratá)? who discerns [it]? for even Mitra, swerving the gods, like a song of praise (çlóka), is the might also of them that go.

verses.sa:
दुर्मन्त्वत्रामृतस्य नाम सलक्ष्मा यद्विषुरूपा भवाति ।
यमस्य यो मनवते सुमन्त्वग्ने तमृष्व पाह्यप्रयुच्छन् ॥
verses.rom:
durmantvatramritasya nama salakshma yadvishurupa bhavati |
yamasya yo manavate sumantvagne tamrishva pahyaprayuchchhan ||
verses.en: Hard to reverence (? durmántu) here is the name of the immortal, that she of like sign should become of diverse form; whoso shall reverence Yama with proper reverence (? sumántu), him, O Agni, exalted one, do thou protect, unremitting.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन् देवा विदथे मादयन्ते विवस्वतः सदने धारयन्ते ।
सूर्ये ज्योतिरदधुर्मास्यक्तून् परि द्योतनिं चरतो अजस्रा ॥
verses.rom:
yasmin deva vidathe madayante vivasvatah sadane dharayante |
surye jyotiradadhurmasyaktun pari dyotanim charato ajasra ||
verses.en: In whom the gods revel at the council, maintain themselves in Vivasvant's seat—they placed light in the sun, rays in the moon: the two, unfailing, wait upon (pari-car) the brightness (dyotaní).

verses.sa:
यस्मिन् देवा मन्मनि संचरन्त्यपीच्ये न वयमस्य विद्म ।
मित्रो नो अत्रादितिरनागान्त्सविता देवो वरुणाय वोचत् ॥
verses.rom:
yasmin deva manmani samcharantyapichye na vayamasya vidma |
mitro no atraditiranagantsavita devo varunaya vochat ||
verses.en: In what secret (apīcyà) devotion (mánman) the gods go about (sam-car)—we know it not; may Mitra, may Aditi, may god Savitar declare us here guiltless to Varuṇa.

verses.sa:
सखाय आ शिषामहे ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे ।
स्तुष ऊ षु नृतमाय धृष्णवे ॥
verses.rom:
sakhaya a shishamahe brahmendraya vajrine |
stusha u shu nritamaya dhrishnave ||
verses.en: O companions, we would supplicate (ā-ças) worship (bráhman) for Indra, possessor of the thunderbolt, to praise, indeed, the most manly, the daring.

verses.sa:
शवसा ह्यसि श्रुतो वृत्रहत्येन वृत्रहा ।
मघैर्मघोनो अति शूर दाशसि ॥
verses.rom:
shavasa hyasi shruto vritrahatyena vritraha |
maghairmaghono ati shura dashasi ||
verses.en: For thou art famed for might (çávas), for Vritra-slaying, a Vritra-slayer; thou out-bestowest the bounteous with thy bounties, O hero.

verses.sa:
स्तेगो न क्षामत्येषि पृथिवीं मही नो वाता इह वान्तु भूमौ ।
मित्रो नो अत्र वरुणो युजमानो अग्निर्वने न व्यसृष्ट शोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
stego na kshamatyeshi prithivim mahi no vata iha vantu bhumau |
mitro no atra varuno yujamano agnirvane na vyasrishta shokam ||
verses.en: Thou goest over the earth as a stegá over the ground; let winds blow here on the great earth (bhū́mi) for us; Mitra for us there (átra), Varuṇa, being joined, hath let loose heat (çóka), as fire does in the forest.

verses.sa:
स्तुहि श्रुतं गर्तसदं जनानां राजानं भीममुपहत्नुमुग्रम् ।
मृडा जरित्रे रुद्र स्तवानो अन्यमस्मत्ते नि वपन्तु सेन्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
stuhi shrutam gartasadam jananam rajanam bhimamupahatnumugram |
mrida jaritre rudra stavano anyamasmatte ni vapantu senyam ||
verses.en: Praise thou the famed sitter on the hollow of men (jána), the terrible king, formidable assailant (? upahatnú); being praised, O Rudra, be gracious to the singer; let thine army (? sénya) lay low (ni-vap) another than us.

verses.sa:
सरस्वतीं देवयन्तो हवन्ते सरस्वतीमध्वरे तायमाने ।
सरस्वतीं सुकृतो हवन्ते सरस्वती दाशुषे वार्यं दात् ॥
verses.rom:
sarasvatim devayanto havante sarasvatimadhvare tayamane |
sarasvatim sukrito havante sarasvati dashushe varyam dat ||
verses.en: On Sarasvatī do the pious call; on Sarasvatī , while the sacrifice is being extended; on Sarasvatī do the well-doers call: may Sarasvatī give what is desirable to the worshiper (dāçvā́ṅs).

verses.sa:
सरस्वतीं पितरो हवन्ते दक्षिणा यज्ञमभिनक्षमाणाः ।
आसद्यास्मिन् बर्हिषि मादयध्वमनमीवा इष आ धेह्यस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
sarasvatim pitaro havante dakshina yajnamabhinakshamanah |
asadyasmin barhishi madayadhvamanamiva isha a dhehyasme ||
verses.en: On Sarasvatī do the Fathers call, arriving at the sacrifice on the south; sitting on this barhís do ye revel; assign thou to us food (íṣas) free from disease.

verses.sa:
सरस्वति या सरथं ययाथोक्थैः स्वधाभिर्देवि पितृभिर्मदन्ती ।
सहस्रार्घमिडो अत्र भागं रायस्पोषं यजमानाय धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
sarasvati ya saratham yayathokthaih svadhabhirdevi pitribhirmadanti |
sahasrarghamido atra bhagam rayasposham yajamanaya dhehi ||
verses.en: O Sarasvatī, that wentest in company (sarátham) with the songs (ukthá), with the svadhā́s, O goddess, reveling with the Fathers, assign thou to the sacrificer here a portion of refreshment (íḍ) of thousandfold value, abundance of wealth.

verses.sa:
उदीरतामवर उत्परास उन् मध्यमाः पितरः सोम्यासः ।
असुं य ईयुरवृका ऋतज्ञास्ते नोऽवन्तु पितरो हवेषु ॥
verses.rom:
udiratamavara utparasa un madhyamah pitarah somyasah |
asum ya iyuravrika ritajnaste no'vantu pitaro haveshu ||
verses.en: Let the lower, let the higher, let the midmost Fathers, the soma-drinking (? somyá), go up; they who went to life (ásu), unharmed (avṛká), right-knowing—let those Fathers aid us at our calls.

verses.sa:
आहं पितॄन्त्सुविदत्रामवित्सि नपातं च विक्रमणं च विष्णोः ।
बर्हिषदो ये स्वधया सुतस्य भजन्त पित्वस्त इहागमिष्ठाः ॥
verses.rom:
aham pitrintsuvidatramavitsi napatam cha vikramanam cha vishnoh |
barhishado ye svadhaya sutasya bhajanta pitvasta ihagamishthah ||
verses.en: I have won hither (ā-vid) the beneficent Fathers, both the grandson and the wide-striding of Vishṇu; they who, sitting on the barhís, partake of the pressed drink with svadhā́—they come especially hither.

verses.sa:
इदं पितृभ्यो नमो अस्त्वद्य ये पूर्वासो ये अपरास ईयुः ।
ये पार्थिवे रजस्या निषक्ता ये वा नूनं सुवृजनासु दिक्षु ॥
verses.rom:
idam pitribhyo namo astvadya ye purvaso ye aparasa iyuh |
ye parthive rajasya nishakta ye va nunam suvrijanasu dikshu ||
verses.en: Be this homage today to the Fathers, who went first, who went after, who are seated in the space (rájas) of earth, or who are now in regions (díç) having good abodes (suvṛjána).

verses.sa:
मातली कव्यैर्यमो अङ्गिरोभिर्बृहस्पतिर्ऋक्वभिर्वावृधानः ।
यांश्च देवा वावृधुर्ये च देवांस्ते नोऽवन्तु पितरो हवेषु ॥
verses.rom:
matali kavyairyamo angirobhirbrihaspatirrikvabhirvavridhanah |
yamshcha deva vavridhurye cha devamste no'vantu pitaro haveshu ||
verses.en: Mātālī with the kavyás, Yama with the An̄girases, Brihaspati increasing with the ṛ́kvans ('praisers'); both they whom the gods increased and who [increased] the gods—let those Fathers aid us at our calls.

verses.sa:
स्वादुष्किलायं मधुमाँ उतायं तीव्रः किलायं रसवाँ उतायम् ।
उतो न्वस्य पपिवांसमिन्द्रं न कश्चन सहत आहवेषु ॥
verses.rom:
svadushkilayam madhuman utayam tivrah kilayam rasavan utayam |
uto nvasya papivamsamindram na kashchana sahata ahaveshu ||
verses.en: Sweet verily is this [sóma], and full of honey is this; strong (tīvrá) verily is this, and full of sap is this; and no one soever overpowers in conflicts (āhavá) Indra, having now drunk of it.

verses.sa:
परेयिवांसं प्रवतो महीरिति बहुभ्यः पन्थामनुपस्पशानम् ।
वैवस्वतं संगमनं जनानां यमं राजानं हविषा सपर्यत ॥
verses.rom:
pareyivamsam pravato mahiriti bahubhyah panthamanupaspashanam |
vaivasvatam samgamanam jananam yamam rajanam havisha saparyata ||
verses.en: Him that went away to the advances called great, spying out the road for many, Vivasvant's son, gatherer of people, king Yama, honor (sapary) ye with oblation.

verses.sa:
यमो नो गातुं प्रथमो विवेद नैषा गव्यूतिरपभर्तवा उ ।
यत्रा नः पूर्वे पितरः परेता एना जज्ञानाः पथ्या अनु स्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
yamo no gatum prathamo viveda naisha gavyutirapabhartava u |
yatra nah purve pitarah pareta ena jajnanah pathya anu svah ||
verses.en: Yama first found for us a track (gātú); that is not a pasture to be borne away; where our former Fathers went forth, there (enā́) [go] those born [of them], along their own roads.

verses.sa:
बर्हिषदः पितर ऊत्यर्वागिमा वो हव्या चकृमा जुषध्वम् ।
त आ गतावसा शंतमेनाधा नः शं योररपो दधात ॥
verses.rom:
barhishadah pitara utyarvagima vo havya chakrima jushadhvam |
ta a gatavasa shamtamenadha nah sham yorarapo dadhata ||
verses.en: Ye barhís-seated Fathers, hitherward with aid! these offerings have we made for you; enjoy [them]! do ye come with most wealful aid; then assign to us weal [and] profit, free from evil.

verses.sa:
आच्या जानु दक्षिणतो निषद्येदं नो हविरभि गृणन्तु विश्वे ।
मा हिंसिष्ट पितरः केन चिन् नो यद्व आगः पुरुषता कराम ॥
verses.rom:
achya janu dakshinato nishadyedam no havirabhi grinantu vishve |
ma himsishta pitarah kena chin no yadva agah purushata karama ||
verses.en: Bending the knee, sitting down on the right, let all assent to (abhi-gṛ) this libation of ours; injure us not, O Fathers, by reason of any offense (ā́gas) which we may do to you through humanity.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा दुहित्रे वहतुं कृणोति तेनेदं विश्वं भुवनं समेति ।
यमस्य माता पर्युह्यमाना महो जाया विवस्वतो ननाश ॥
verses.rom:
tvashta duhitre vahatum krinoti tenedam vishvam bhuvanam sameti |
yamasya mata paryuhyamana maho jaya vivasvato nanasha ||
verses.en: Tvashṭar makes a wedding-car for his daughter; by reason of this, all this creation comes together; the mother of Yama, wife of great Vivasvant, being drawn about, disappeared.

verses.sa:
प्रेहि प्रेहि पथिभिः पूर्याणैर्येना ते पूर्वे पितरः परेताः ।
उभा राजानौ स्वधया मदन्तौ यमं पश्यासि वरुणं च देवम् ॥
verses.rom:
prehi prehi pathibhih puryanairyena te purve pitarah paretah |
ubha rajanau svadhaya madantau yamam pashyasi varunam cha devam ||
verses.en: Go thou forth, go forth by roads that go to the stronghold (pūryā́ṇa), as (yénā) thy Fathers of old went forth; both kings, reveling with svadhā́, shalt thou see, Yama and god Varuṇa.

verses.sa:
अपेत वीत वि च सर्पतातोऽस्मा एतं पितरो लोकमक्रन् ।
अहोभिरद्भिरक्तुभिर्व्यक्तं यमो ददात्यवसानमस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
apeta vita vi cha sarpatato'sma etam pitaro lokamakran |
ahobhiradbhiraktubhirvyaktam yamo dadatyavasanamasmai ||
verses.en: Go ye away, go asunder, and creep apart from here; for this man the Fathers have made this world; adorned with days, with waters, with rays (aktú), a rest (avasā́na) Yama gives to him.

verses.sa:
उशन्तस्त्वेधीमह्युशन्तः समिधीमहि ।
उशन्न् उशत आ वह पितॄन् हविषे अत्तवे ॥
verses.rom:
ushantastvedhimahyushantah samidhimahi |
ushann ushata a vaha pitrin havishe attave ||
verses.en: Eager (uçánt) would we light thee, eager would we kindle; do thou, eager, bring the eager Fathers to eat the oblation.

verses.sa:
द्युमन्तस्त्वेधीमहि द्युमन्तः समिधीमहि ।
द्युमान् द्युमत आ वह पितॄन् हविषे अत्तवे ॥
verses.rom:
dyumantastvedhimahi dyumantah samidhimahi |
dyuman dyumata a vaha pitrin havishe attave ||
verses.en: Lightful (dyumánt) would we light thee, lightful would we kindle; do thou, lightful, bring the lightful Fathers to eat the oblation.

verses.sa:
अङ्गिरसो नः पितरो नवग्वा अथर्वाणो भृगवः सोम्यासः ।
तेषां वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियानामपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
angiraso nah pitaro navagva atharvano bhrigavah somyasah |
tesham vayam sumatau yajniyanamapi bhadre saumanase syama ||
verses.en: The An̄girases, our návagva Fathers, the Atharvans, the Bhṛigus, soma-drinkers (somyá)—may we be in the favor of those worshipful ones, likewise in their excellent well-willing.

verses.sa:
अङ्गिरोभिर्यज्ञियैरा गहीह यम वैरूपैरिह मादयस्व ।
विवस्वन्तं हुवे यः पिता तेऽस्मिन् बर्हिष्या निषद्य ॥
verses.rom:
angirobhiryajniyaira gahiha yama vairupairiha madayasva |
vivasvantam huve yah pita te'smin barhishya nishadya ||
verses.en: Come thou hither with the worshipful An̄girases; revel here, O Yama, with the Vāirūpas—I call Vivasvant, who is thy father—sitting down upon this barhís.

verses.sa:
इमं यम प्रस्तरमा हि रोहाङ्गिरोभिः पितृभिः संविदानः ।
आ त्वा मन्त्राः कविशस्ता वहन्त्वेना राजन् हविषो मादयस्व ॥
verses.rom:
imam yama prastarama hi rohangirobhih pitribhih samvidanah |
a tva mantrah kavishasta vahantvena rajan havisho madayasva ||
verses.en: Ascend thou, O Yama, this cushion (prastará), in concord with the An̄giras Fathers; let the sacred utterances (mántra) made in praise by the poets bring thee; then (enā́), O king, revel thou in the oblation.

verses.sa:
इत एत उदारुहन् दिवस्पृष्ठान्वारुहन् ।
प्र भूर्जयो यथा पथा द्यामङ्गिरसो ययुः ॥
verses.rom:
ita eta udaruhan divasprishthanvaruhan |
pra bhurjayo yatha patha dyamangiraso yayuh ||
verses.en: These ascended up from here; they ascended the backs of the sky (dív); the An̄girases have gone forth to heaven (dív), like bhūrjís, by the road.

verses.sa:
यमाय सोमः पवते यमाय क्रियते हविः ।
यमं ह यज्ञो गच्छत्यग्निदूतो अरंकृतः ॥
verses.rom:
yamaya somah pavate yamaya kriyate havih |
yamam ha yajno gachchhatyagniduto aramkritah ||
verses.en: For Yama the soma purifies itself; for Yama is made the oblation; to Yama goes the sacrifice, messengered by Agni, made satisfactory.

verses.sa:
यमाय मधुमत्तमं जुहोता प्र च तिष्ठत ।
इदं नम ऋषिभ्यः पूर्वजेभ्यः पूर्वेभ्यः पथिकृद्भ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yamaya madhumattamam juhota pra cha tishthata |
idam nama rishibhyah purvajebhyah purvebhyah pathikridbhyah ||
verses.en: Offer ye to Yama what is most honeyed, and stand forth; this homage to the former-born, the former, the path-making seers.

verses.sa:
यमाय घृतवत्पयो राज्ञे हविर्जुहोतन ।
स नो जीवेष्वा यमेद्दीर्घमायुः प्र जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yamaya ghritavatpayo rajne havirjuhotana |
sa no jiveshva yameddirghamayuh pra jivase ||
verses.en: Unto Yama the king offer ye an oblation, milk rich in ghee; he furnishes (ā-yam) to us among the living a long life-time, for living on.

verses.sa:
मैनमग्ने वि दहो माभि शूशुचो मास्य त्वचं चिक्षिपो मा शरीरम् ।
शृतं यदा करसि जातवेदोऽथेमेनं प्र हिणुतात्पितॄंरुप ॥
verses.rom:
mainamagne vi daho mabhi shushucho masya tvacham chikshipo ma shariram |
shritam yada karasi jatavedo'themenam pra hinutatpitrimrupa ||
verses.en: Do not, O Agni, burn him up; do not be hot upon (abhi-çuc) him; do not warp (kṣip) his skin, nor his body; when thou shalt make him done, O Jātavedas, then send him forward unto the Fathers.

verses.sa:
यदा शृतं कृणवो जातवेदोऽथेममेनं परि दत्तात्पितृभ्यः ।
यदो गछात्यसुनीतिमेतामथ देवानां वशनीर्भवाति ॥
verses.rom:
yada shritam krinavo jatavedo'themamenam pari dattatpitribhyah |
yado gachhatyasunitimetamatha devanam vashanirbhavati ||
verses.en: When thou shalt make him done, O Jātavedas, then commit him to the Fathers; when he shall go to that other life (ásunīti), then shall he become a controller (? vaçanī́) of the gods.

verses.sa:
त्रिकद्रुकेभिः पवते षडुर्वीरेकमिद्बृहत्।
त्रिष्टुब्गायत्री छन्दांसि सर्वा ता यम आर्पिता ॥
verses.rom:
trikadrukebhih pavate shadurvirekamidbrihat|
trishtubgayatri chhandamsi sarva ta yama arpita ||
verses.en: With the trikadrukas it purifies itself; six wide ones, verily one great one; triṣṭúbh, gāyatrī́, the meters: all those [are] set in Yama.

verses.sa:
सूर्यं चक्षुषा गच्छ वातमात्मना दिवं च गच्छ पृथिवीं च धर्मभिः ।
अपो वा गच्छ यदि तत्र ते हितमोषधीषु प्रति तिष्ठा शरीरैः ॥
verses.rom:
suryam chakshusha gachchha vatamatmana divam cha gachchha prithivim cha dharmabhih |
apo va gachchha yadi tatra te hitamoshadhishu prati tishtha shariraih ||
verses.en: Go thou to the sun with thine eye, to the wind with thy soul (ātmán); go both to heaven and to earth with [their] due shares (? dhárman); or go to the waters, if there it is acceptable (hitá) to thee; in the herbs stand firm with thy bodies.

verses.sa:
अजो भागस्तपसस्तं तपस्व तं ते शोचिस्तपतु तं ते अर्चिः ।
यास्ते शिवास्तन्वो जातवेदस्ताभिर्वहैनं सुकृतामु लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
ajo bhagastapasastam tapasva tam te shochistapatu tam te archih |
yaste shivastanvo jatavedastabhirvahainam sukritamu lokam ||
verses.en: The goat is the share of the heat (tápas); heat thou that; that let thine ardor (çocís) heat, that thy flame (arcís); what propitious bodies (tanū́) are thine, O Jātavedas, with them carry him to the world of the well-doing.

verses.sa:
यास्ते शोचयो रंहयो जातवेदो याभिरापृणासि दिवमन्तरिक्षम् ।
अजं यन्तमनु ताः समृण्वतामथेतराभिः शिवतमाभिः शृतं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
yaste shochayo ramhayo jatavedo yabhiraprinasi divamantariksham |
ajam yantamanu tah samrinvatamathetarabhih shivatamabhih shritam kridhi ||
verses.en: What ardors (çocí), swiftnesses (ráṅhi) are thine, O Jātavedas, with which thou fillest the sky, the atmosphere, let them collect (sam-ṛ) after the goat as he goes; then with other most propitious ones make him propitious.

verses.sa:
अव सृज पुनरग्ने पितृभ्यो यस्त आहुतश्चरति स्वधावान् ।
आयुर्वसान उप यातु शेषः सं गच्छतां तन्वा सुवर्चाः ॥
verses.rom:
ava srija punaragne pitribhyo yasta ahutashcharati svadhavan |
ayurvasana upa yatu sheshah sam gachchhatam tanva suvarchah ||
verses.en: Release again, O Agni, to the Fathers him who goes (car) offered to thee, with svadhā́; clothing himself in life (ā́yus), let him go unto [his] posterity (? çéṣas); let him be united with a body, very splendid.

verses.sa:
अति द्रव श्वानौ सारमेयौ चतुरक्षौ शबलौ साधुना पथा ।
अधा पितॄन्त्सुविदत्रामपीहि यमेन ये सधमादं मदन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
ati drava shvanau sarameyau chaturakshau shabalau sadhuna patha |
adha pitrintsuvidatramapihi yamena ye sadhamadam madanti ||
verses.en: Run thou past the two four-eyed, brindled dogs of Saramā, by a happy (sādhú) road; then go unto the beneficent Fathers, who revel in common revelry with Yama.

verses.sa:
यौ ते श्वानौ यम रक्षितारौ चतुरक्षौ पथिषदी नृचक्षसा ।
ताभ्यां राजन् परि धेह्येनं स्वस्त्यस्मा अनमीवं च धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
yau te shvanau yama rakshitarau chaturakshau pathishadi nrichakshasa |
tabhyam rajan pari dhehyenam svastyasma anamivam cha dhehi ||
verses.en: What two defending dogs thou hast, O Yama, four-eyed, sitting by the road, men-watching, with them, O king, do thou surround him; assign to him well-being and freedom from disease.

verses.sa:
उरूणसावसुतृपावुदुम्बलौ यमस्य दूतौ चरतो जनामनु ।
तावस्मभ्यं दृशये सूर्याय पुनर्दातामसुमद्येह भद्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
urunasavasutripavudumbalau yamasya dutau charato janamanu |
tavasmabhyam drishaye suryaya punardatamasumadyeha bhadram ||
verses.en: Broad-nosed, feeding on lives (? asutṛ́p), copper-colored, Yama's two messengers go about after men (jána); let them give us back here today excellent life (ásu), to see the sun.

verses.sa:
सोम एकेभ्यः पवते घृतमेक उपासते ।
येभ्यो मधु प्रधावति तांश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.rom:
soma ekebhyah pavate ghritameka upasate |
yebhyo madhu pradhavati tamshchidevapi gachchhatat ||
verses.en: Soma purifies itself for some; some wait upon (upa-ās) ghee; for whom honey runs forward (?), unto them do thou go.

verses.sa:
ये चित्पूर्व ऋतसाता ऋतजाता ऋतावृधः ।
ऋषीन् तपस्वतो यम तपोजामपि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.rom:
ye chitpurva ritasata ritajata ritavridhah |
rishin tapasvato yama tapojamapi gachchhatat ||
verses.en: They who of old were won by right, born of right, increasers of right—to the seers rich in fervor (tápas-), born of fervor, O Yama, do thou go.

verses.sa:
तपसा ये अनाधृष्यास्तपसा ये स्वर्ययुः ।
तपो ये चक्रिरे महस्तांश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.rom:
tapasa ye anadhrishyastapasa ye svaryayuh |
tapo ye chakrire mahastamshchidevapi gachchhatat ||
verses.en: They who by fervor are unassailable, who by fervor have gone to heaven (svàr), who made fervor their greatness, unto them do thou go.

verses.sa:
ये युध्यन्ते प्रधनेषु शूरासो ये स्वर्तनूत्यजः ।
ये वा सहस्रदक्षिणास्तां चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.rom:
ye yudhyante pradhaneshu shuraso ye svartanutyajah |
ye va sahasradakshinastam chidevapi gachchhatat ||
verses.en: They who fight in the contests (pradhána), who are self-sacrificing (tanūtyáj) heroes, or who give thousand-fold sacrificial gifts, unto them do thou go.

verses.sa:
सहस्रणीथाः कवयो ये गोपायन्ति सूर्यम् ।
ऋषीन् तपस्वतो यम तपोजामपि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasranithah kavayo ye gopayanti suryam |
rishin tapasvato yama tapojamapi gachchhatat ||
verses.en: Poets (kaví) of a thousand lays (-nīthá), who guard the sun—to the seers rich in fervor, born of fervor, O Yama, do thou go.

verses.sa:
स्योनास्मै भव पृथिव्यनृक्षरा निवेशनी ।
यछास्मै शर्म सप्रथाः ॥
verses.rom:
syonasmai bhava prithivyanrikshara niveshani |
yachhasmai sharma saprathah ||
verses.en: Be pleasant to him, O earth, a thornless resting-place; furnish him broad refuge.

verses.sa:
असंबाधे पृथिव्या उरौ लोके नि धीयस्व ।
स्वधा याश्चकृषे जीवन् तास्ते सन्तु मधुश्चुतः ॥
verses.rom:
asambadhe prithivya urau loke ni dhiyasva |
svadha yashchakrishe jivan taste santu madhushchutah ||
verses.en: In the unoppressive wide space (loká) of earth be thou deposited; what svadhā́s thou didst make when living, be they dripping with honey for thee.

verses.sa:
ह्वयामि ते मनसा मन इहेमान् गृहामुप जुजुषाण एहि ।
सं गच्छस्व पितृभिः सं यमेन स्योनास्त्वा वाता उप वान्तु शग्माः ॥
verses.rom:
hvayami te manasa mana iheman grihamupa jujushana ehi |
sam gachchhasva pitribhih sam yamena syonastva vata upa vantu shagmah ||
verses.en: I call thy mind hither with mind; come unto these houses, enjoying [them]; unite thyself with the Fathers, with Yama; let pleasant, helpful (? çagmá) winds blow thee unto [them].

verses.sa:
उत्त्वा वहन्तु मरुत उदवाहा उदप्रुतः ।
अजेन कृण्वन्तः शीतं वर्षेणोक्षन्तु बालिति ॥
verses.rom:
uttva vahantu maruta udavaha udaprutah |
ajena krinvantah shitam varshenokshantu baliti ||
verses.en: Let the water-carrying, water-floating Maruts carry thee up, making [thee] cool by the goat, let them sprinkle [thee] with rain, splash!

verses.sa:
उदह्वमायुरायुषे क्रत्वे दक्षाय जीवसे ।
स्वान् गच्छतु ते मनो अधा पितॄंरुप द्रव ॥
verses.rom:
udahvamayurayushe kratve dakshaya jivase |
svan gachchhatu te mano adha pitrimrupa drava ||
verses.en: I have called up life-time unto life-time, unto ability (krátu), unto dexterity, unto life; let thy mind go to its own pl.; then run unto the Fathers.

verses.sa:
मा ते मनो मासोर्माङ्गानां मा रसस्य ते ।
मा ते हास्त तन्वः किं चनेह ॥
verses.rom:
ma te mano masormanganam ma rasasya te |
ma te hasta tanvah kim chaneha ||
verses.en: Let nothing whatever of thy mind, nor of thy life (ásu), nor of thy members, nor of thy sap, nor of thy body, be left here.

verses.sa:
मा त्वा वृक्षः सं बाधिष्ट मा देवी पृथिवी मही ।
लोकं पितृषु वित्त्वैधस्व यमराजसु ॥
verses.rom:
ma tva vrikshah sam badhishta ma devi prithivi mahi |
lokam pitrishu vittvaidhasva yamarajasu ||
verses.en: Let not the tree oppress thee, nor the great divine earth; having found a place (loká) among the Fathers, thrive (edh) thou among those whose king is Yama.

verses.sa:
यत्ते अङ्गमतिहितं पराचैरपानः प्राणो य उ वा ते परेतः ।
तत्ते संगत्य पितरः सनीडा घासाद्घासं पुनरा वेशयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yatte angamatihitam parachairapanah prano ya u va te paretah |
tatte samgatya pitarah sanida ghasadghasam punara veshayantu ||
verses.en: What limb of thine is put over at a distance, and what expiration [or] breath has gone forth upon the wind (?), let the associated (sánīḍa) Fathers, assembling, make that enter thee again, bit (ghāsá) from bit.

verses.sa:
अपेमं जीवा अरुधन् गृहेभ्यस्तं निर्वहत परि ग्रामादितः ।
मृत्युर्यमस्यासीद्दूतः प्रचेता असून् पितृभ्यो गमयां चकार ॥
verses.rom:
apemam jiva arudhan grihebhyastam nirvahata pari gramaditah |
mrityuryamasyasiddutah pracheta asun pitribhyo gamayam chakara ||
verses.en: The living have excluded this man from their houses; carry ye him out, forth from this village; death was the kindly messenger of Yama; he made his life-breaths (ásu) go to the Fathers.

verses.sa:
ये दस्यवः पितृषु प्रविष्टा ज्ञातिमुखा अहुतादश्चरन्ति ।
परापुरो निपुरो ये भरन्त्यग्निष्टान् अस्मात्प्र धमाति यज्ञात् ॥
verses.rom:
ye dasyavah pitrishu pravishta jnatimukha ahutadashcharanti |
parapuro nipuro ye bharantyagnishtan asmatpra dhamati yajnat ||
verses.en: What barbarians (dásyu), having entered among the Fathers, having faces of acquaintances, go about, eating what is not sacrificed, who bear parāpúr [and] nipúr—Agni shall blast (dham) them forth from this sacrifice.

verses.sa:
सं विशन्त्विह पितरः स्वा नः स्योनं कृण्वन्तः प्रतिरन्त आयुः ।
तेभ्यः शकेम हविषा नक्षमाणा ज्योग्जीवन्तः शरदः पुरूचीः ॥
verses.rom:
sam vishantviha pitarah sva nah syonam krinvantah pratiranta ayuh |
tebhyah shakema havisha nakshamana jyogjivantah sharadah puruchih ||
verses.en: Let there enter together (sam-viç) here our own Fathers, doing what is pleasant, lengthening [our] life-time; may we be able to reach them with oblation, living long for numerous autumns.

verses.sa:
यां ते धेनुं निपृणामि यमु क्षीर ओदनम् ।
तेना जनस्यासो भर्ता योऽत्रासदजीवनः ॥
verses.rom:
yam te dhenum niprinami yamu kshira odanam |
tena janasyaso bharta yo'trasadajivanah ||
verses.en: What milch-cow I set down (ni-pṛ) for thee, and what rice-dish for thee in milk (kṣīrá)—with that mayest thou be the supporter of the person (jána) who is there (átra) without a living.

verses.sa:
अश्वावतीं प्र तर या सुशेवा र्क्षाकं वा प्रतरं नवीयः ।
यस्त्वा जघान वध्यः सो अस्तु मा सो अन्यद्विदत भागधेयम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashvavatim pra tara ya susheva rkshakam va prataram naviyah |
yastva jaghana vadhyah so astu ma so anyadvidata bhagadheyam ||
verses.en: Pass forward [over a stream] rich in horses, which is very propitious, or, further on, an ṛkṣā́ka, more new; he who slew thee, be he one to be killed; let him not find any other portion.

verses.sa:
यमः परोऽवरो विवस्वान् ततः परं नाति पश्यामि किं चन ।
यमे अध्वरो अधि मे निविष्टो भुवो विवस्वान् अन्वाततान ॥
verses.rom:
yamah paro'varo vivasvan tatah param nati pashyami kim chana |
yame adhvaro adhi me nivishto bhuvo vivasvan anvatatana ||
verses.en: Yama beyond, below Vivasvant—beyond that do I see nothing whatever; into Yama has entered my sacrifice; Vivasvant stretched after the worlds (bhū́).

verses.sa:
अपागूहन्न् अमृतां मर्त्येभ्यः कृत्वा सवर्णामदधुर्विवस्वते ।
उताश्विनावभरद्यत्तदासीदजहादु द्वा मिथुना सरण्यूः ॥
verses.rom:
apaguhann amritam martyebhyah kritva savarnamadadhurvivasvate |
utashvinavabharadyattadasidajahadu dva mithuna saranyuh ||
verses.en: They hid away the immortal one (f.) from mortals; having made one of like color, they gave her to Vivasvant; what that was carried also the two Açvins; and Saraṇyū deserted two twins.

verses.sa:
ये निखाता ये परोप्ता ये दग्धा ये चोद्धिताः ।
सर्वांस्तान् अग्न आ वह पितॄन् हविषे अत्तवे ॥
verses.rom:
ye nikhata ye paropta ye dagdha ye choddhitah |
sarvamstan agna a vaha pitrin havishe attave ||
verses.en: They that are buried, and they that are scattered (vap) away, they that are burned and they that are set up (úddhita)—all those Fathers, O Agni, bring thou to eat the oblation.

verses.sa:
ये अग्निदग्धा ये अनग्निदग्धा मध्ये दिवः स्वधया मादयन्ते ।
त्वं तान् वेत्थ यदि ते जातवेदः स्वधया यज्ञं स्वधितिं जुषन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye agnidagdha ye anagnidagdha madhye divah svadhaya madayante |
tvam tan vettha yadi te jatavedah svadhaya yajnam svadhitim jushantam ||
verses.en: They who, burned with fire, [and] who, not burned with fire, revel on svadhā́ in the midst of heaven—them thou knowest, if thine, O Jātavedas; let them enjoy with svadhā́ the sacrifice, the svádhiti.

verses.sa:
शं तप माति तपो अग्ने मा तन्वं तपः ।
वणेषु शुष्मो अस्तु ते पृथिव्यामस्तु यद्धरः ॥
verses.rom:
sham tapa mati tapo agne ma tanvam tapah |
vaneshu shushmo astu te prithivyamastu yaddharah ||
verses.en: Burn (tap) thou propitiously (çám); do not burn overmuch; O Agni, do not burn the body; be thy vehemence (çúṣma) in the woods; on the earth be what is thy violence (háras).

verses.sa:
ददाम्यस्मा अवसानमेतद्य एष आगन् मम चेदभूदिह ।
यमश्चिकित्वान् प्रत्येतदाह ममैष राय उप तिष्ठतामिह ॥
verses.rom:
dadamyasma avasanametadya esha agan mama chedabhudiha |
yamashchikitvan pratyetadaha mamaisha raya upa tishthatamiha ||
verses.en: I give this release to him who hath thus come and hath become mine here—thus replies the knowing Yama—let this one approach (upa-sthā) my wealth here.

verses.sa:
इमां मात्रां मिमीमहे यथापरं न मासातै ।
शते शरत्सु नो पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
imam matram mimimahe yathaparam na masatai |
shate sharatsu no pura ||
verses.en: This measure do we measure, so that one may not measure further; in a hundred autumns, not before.

verses.sa:
प्रेमां मात्रां मिमीमहे यथापरं न मासातै ।
शते शरत्सु नो पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
premam matram mimimahe yathaparam na masatai |
shate sharatsu no pura ||
verses.en: This measure do we measure forth, so that etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अपेमां मात्रां मिमीमहे यथापरं न मासातै ।
शते शरत्सु नो पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
apemam matram mimimahe yathaparam na masatai |
shate sharatsu no pura ||
verses.en: This measure do we measure off, so that etc. etc.

verses.sa:
वीमां मात्रां मिमीमहे यथापरं न मासातै ।
शते शरत्सु नो पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
vimam matram mimimahe yathaparam na masatai |
shate sharatsu no pura ||
verses.en: This measure do we measure apart, so that etc. etc.

verses.sa:
निरिमां मात्रां मिमीमहे यथापरं न मासातै ।
शते शरत्सु नो पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
nirimam matram mimimahe yathaparam na masatai |
shate sharatsu no pura ||
verses.en: This measure do we measure out, so that etc. etc.

verses.sa:
उदिमां मात्रां मिमीमहे यथापरं न मासातै ।
शते शरत्सु नो पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
udimam matram mimimahe yathaparam na masatai |
shate sharatsu no pura ||
verses.en: This measure do we measure up, so that etc. etc.

verses.sa:
समिमां मात्रां मिमीमहे यथापरं न मासातै ।
शते शरत्सु नो पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
samimam matram mimimahe yathaparam na masatai |
shate sharatsu no pura ||
verses.en: This measure do we measure together, so that etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अमासि मात्रां स्वरगामायुष्मान् भूयासम् ।
यथापरं न मासातै शते शरत्सु नो पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
amasi matram svaragamayushman bhuyasam |
yathaparam na masatai shate sharatsu no pura ||
verses.en: I have measured the measure, I have gone to heaven (svàr); may I be long-lived; so that etc. etc.

verses.sa:
प्राणो अपानो व्यान आयुश्चक्षुर्दृशये सूर्याय ।
अपरिपरेण पथा यमराज्ञः पितॄन् गच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
prano apano vyana ayushchakshurdrishaye suryaya |
apariparena patha yamarajnah pitrin gachchha ||
verses.en: Breath, expiration, through-breathing (vyāná), life-time, an eye to see the sun: by a road not beset with enemies (-pára) go thou to the Fathers whose king is Yama.

verses.sa:
ये अग्रवः शशमानाः परेयुर्हित्वा द्वेषांस्यनपत्यवन्तः ।
ते द्यामुदित्याविदन्त लोकं नाकस्य पृष्ठे अधि दीध्यानाः ॥
verses.rom:
ye agravah shashamanah pareyurhitva dveshamsyanapatyavantah |
te dyamudityavidanta lokam nakasya prishthe adhi didhyanah ||
verses.en: They that departed unmarried [but] assiduous, abandoning hatreds, having no progeny—they, going up to heaven (div), have found a place (loká), they, shining (? dī́dhyāna) upon the back of the firmament.

verses.sa:
उदन्वती द्यौरवमा पीलुमतीति मध्यमा ।
तृतीया ह प्रद्यौरिति यस्यां पितर आसते ॥
verses.rom:
udanvati dyauravama pilumatiti madhyama |
tritiya ha pradyauriti yasyam pitara asate ||
verses.en: Watery is the lowest heaven (dív), full of stars (? pīlu-) is called the midmost; the third is called the fore-heaven (pradív), in which the Fathers sit.

verses.sa:
ये न पितुः पितरो ये पितामहा य आविविशुरुर्वन्तरिक्षम् ।
य आक्षियन्ति पृथिवीमुत द्यां तेभ्यः पितृभ्यो नमसा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
ye na pituh pitaro ye pitamaha ya avivishururvantariksham |
ya akshiyanti prithivimuta dyam tebhyah pitribhyo namasa vidhema ||
verses.en: They that are our father's fathers, that are [his] grandfathers, that entered the wide atmosphere, they that dwell upon earth and heaven (dív)—to those Fathers would we pay worship with homage.

verses.sa:
इदमिद्वा उ नापरं दिवि पश्यसि सूर्यम् ।
माता पुत्रं यथा सिचाभ्येनं भूम ऊर्णुहि ॥
verses.rom:
idamidva u naparam divi pashyasi suryam |
mata putram yatha sichabhyenam bhuma urnuhi ||
verses.en: This time, verily, not further (áparam), seest thou the sun in the heaven (dív); as a mother her son with her hem (síc), do thou cover him, O earth.

verses.sa:
इदमिद्वा उ नापरं जरस्यन्यदितोऽपरम् ।
जाया पतिमिव वाससाभ्येनं भूम ऊर्णुहि ॥
verses.rom:
idamidva u naparam jarasyanyadito'param |
jaya patimiva vasasabhyenam bhuma urnuhi ||
verses.en: This time, verily; not further; in old age another further than this; as a wife her husband with her garment, do thou cover him, O earth (bhū́mi).

verses.sa:
अभि त्वोर्णोमि पृथिव्या मातुर्वस्त्रेण भद्रया ।
जीवेषु भद्रं तन् मयि स्वधा पितृषु सा त्वयि ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tvornomi prithivya maturvastrena bhadraya |
jiveshu bhadram tan mayi svadha pitrishu sa tvayi ||
verses.en: I cover thee excellently with the garment of mother earth; what is excellent among the living, that with me; svadhā́ among the Fathers, that with thee.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा पथिकृता स्योनं देवेभ्यो रत्नं दधथुर्वि लोकम् ।
उप प्रेष्यन्तं पूषणं यो वहात्यञ्जोयानैः पथिभिस्तत्र गच्छतम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnishoma pathikrita syonam devebhyo ratnam dadhathurvi lokam |
upa preshyantam pushanam yo vahatyanjoyanaih pathibhistatra gachchhatam ||
verses.en: O Agni-and-Soma, makers of roads, ye have distributed (vi-dhā) to the gods a pleasant treasure [and] world; send ye unto [us] Pūshan, who shall carry by goat-traveled roads him that goes thither.

verses.sa:
पूषा त्वेतश्च्यावयतु प्र विद्वान् अनष्टपशुर्भुवनस्य गोपाः ।
स त्वैतेभ्यः परि ददत्पितृभ्योऽग्निर्देवेभ्यः सुविदत्रियेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
pusha tvetashchyavayatu pra vidvan anashtapashurbhuvanasya gopah |
sa tvaitebhyah pari dadatpitribhyo'gnirdevebhyah suvidatriyebhyah ||
verses.en: Let Pūshan, knowing, urge thee forth from here—he, the shepherd of creation (bhúvana) who loses no cattle; may he commit thee to those Fathers, [and] Agni to the beneficent gods.

verses.sa:
आयुर्विश्वायुः परि पातु त्वा पूषा त्वा पातु प्रपथे पुरस्तात्।
यत्रासते सुकृतो यत्र त ईयुस्तत्र त्वा देवः सविता दधातु ॥
verses.rom:
ayurvishvayuh pari patu tva pusha tva patu prapathe purastat|
yatrasate sukrito yatra ta iyustatra tva devah savita dadhatu ||
verses.en: May life-time, having all life-time, protect thee about; let Pūshan protect thee in front on the forward road; where sit the well-doers, whither they have gone, there let god Savitar set thee.

verses.sa:
इमौ युनज्मि ते वह्नी असुनीताय वोढवे ।
ताभ्यां यमस्य सादनं समितिश्चाव गच्छतात् ॥
verses.rom:
imau yunajmi te vahni asunitaya vodhave |
tabhyam yamasya sadanam samitishchava gachchhatat ||
verses.en: I yoke for thee these two conveyers váhni, to convey (vah) thee to the other life; with them to Yama's seat and to the assemblies go thou down (áva).

verses.sa:
एतत्त्वा वासः प्रथमं न्वागन्न् अपैतदूह यदिहाबिभः पुरा ।
इष्टापूर्तमनुसंक्राम विद्वान् यत्र ते दत्तं बहुधा विबन्धुषु ॥
verses.rom:
etattva vasah prathamam nvagann apaitaduha yadihabibhah pura |
ishtapurtamanusamkrama vidvan yatra te dattam bahudha vibandhushu ||
verses.en: This garment hath now come first to thee; remove (apa-ūh) that one which thou didst wear here before; knowing, do thou follow along with what is offered and bestowed, where it is given thee variously among them of various connection (? víbandhu).

verses.sa:
अग्नेर्वर्म परि गोभिर्व्ययस्व सं प्रोर्णुष्व मेदसा पीवसा च ।
नेत्त्वा धृष्णुर्हरसा जर्हृषाणो दधृग्विधक्षन् परीङ्खयातै ॥
verses.rom:
agnervarma pari gobhirvyayasva sam prornushva medasa pivasa cha |
nettva dhrishnurharasa jarhrishano dadhrigvidhakshan parinkhayatai ||
verses.en: Wrap about thee of kine a protection from the fire; cover thyself up with grease and fatness, lest the bold one, exulting with violence (háras), shake thee strongly (dadṛ́ḥ) about, intending to consume thee.

verses.sa:
दण्डं हस्तादाददानो गतासोः सह श्रोत्रेण वर्चसा बलेन ।
अत्रैव त्वमिह वयं सुवीरा विश्वा मृधो अभिमातीर्जयेम ॥
verses.rom:
dandam hastadadadano gatasoh saha shrotrena varchasa balena |
atraiva tvamiha vayam suvira vishva mridho abhimatirjayema ||
verses.en: Taking the staff from the hand of the deceased man (gatā́su), together with hearing, splendor, strength—thou just there, here may we, rich in heroes, conquer all scorners [and] evil plotters.

verses.sa:
धनुर्हस्तादाददानो मृतस्य सह क्षत्रेण वर्चसा बलेन ।
समागृभाय वसु भूरि पुष्टमर्वाङ्त्वमेह्युप जीवलोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhanurhastadadadano mritasya saha kshatrena varchasa balena |
samagribhaya vasu bhuri pushtamarvantvamehyupa jivalokam ||
verses.en: Taking the bow from the hand of the dead man, together with authority (kṣatrá), splendor, strength—take thou hold upon much prosperous good; come thou hitherward unto the world of the living.

verses.sa:
इयं नारी पतिलोकं वृणाना नि पद्यत उप त्वा मर्त्य प्रेतम् ।
धर्मं पुराणमनुपालयन्ती तस्यै प्रजां द्रविणं चेह धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
iyam nari patilokam vrinana ni padyata upa tva martya pretam |
dharmam puranamanupalayanti tasyai prajam dravinam cheha dhehi ||

verses.sa:
उदीर्ष्व नार्यभि जीवलोकं गतासुमेतमुप शेष एहि ।
हस्तग्राभस्य दधिषोस्तवेदं पत्युर्जनित्वमभि सं बभूथ ॥
verses.rom:
udirshva naryabhi jivalokam gatasumetamupa shesha ehi |
hastagrabhasya dadhishostavedam patyurjanitvamabhi sam babhutha ||

verses.sa:
अपश्यं युवतिं नीयमानां जीवां मृतेभ्यः परिणीयमानाम् ।
अन्धेन यत्तमसा प्रावृतासीत्प्राक्तो अपाचीमनयं तदेनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
apashyam yuvatim niyamanam jivam mritebhyah pariniyamanam |
andhena yattamasa pravritasitprakto apachimanayam tadenam ||

verses.sa:
प्रजानत्यघ्न्ये जीवलोकं देवानां पन्थामनुसंचरन्ती ।
अयं ते गोपतिस्तं जुषस्व स्वर्गं लोकमधि रोहयैनम् ॥
verses.rom:
prajanatyaghnye jivalokam devanam panthamanusamcharanti |
ayam te gopatistam jushasva svargam lokamadhi rohayainam ||

verses.sa:
उप द्यामुप वेतसमवत्तरो नदीनाम् ।
अग्ने पित्तमपामसि ॥
verses.rom:
upa dyamupa vetasamavattaro nadinam |
agne pittamapamasi ||

verses.sa:
यं त्वमग्ने समदहस्तमु निर्वापय पुनः ।
क्याम्बूरत्र रोहतु शाण्डदूर्वा व्यल्कशा ॥
verses.rom:
yam tvamagne samadahastamu nirvapaya punah |
kyamburatra rohatu shandadurva vyalkasha ||

verses.sa:
इदं त एकं पुर ऊ त एकं तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा सं विशस्व ।
संवेशने तन्वा चारुरेधि प्रियो देवानां परमे सधस्थे ॥
verses.rom:
idam ta ekam pura u ta ekam tritiyena jyotisha sam vishasva |
samveshane tanva charuredhi priyo devanam parame sadhasthe ||

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठ प्रेहि प्र द्रवौकः कृणुष्व सलिले सधस्थे ।
तत्र त्वं पितृभिः संविदानः सं सोमेन मदस्व सं स्वधाभिः ॥
verses.rom:
uttishtha prehi pra dravaukah krinushva salile sadhasthe |
tatra tvam pitribhih samvidanah sam somena madasva sam svadhabhih ||

verses.sa:
प्र च्यवस्व तन्वं सं भरस्व मा ते गात्रा वि हायि मो शरीरम् ।
मनो निविष्टमनुसंविशस्व यत्र भूमेर्जुषसे तत्र गच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
pra chyavasva tanvam sam bharasva ma te gatra vi hayi mo shariram |
mano nivishtamanusamvishasva yatra bhumerjushase tatra gachchha ||

verses.sa:
वर्चसा मां पितरः सोम्यासो अञ्जन्तु देवा मधुना घृतेन ।
चक्षुषे मा प्रतरं तारयन्तो जरसे मा जरदष्टिं वर्धन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
varchasa mam pitarah somyaso anjantu deva madhuna ghritena |
chakshushe ma prataram tarayanto jarase ma jaradashtim vardhantu ||

verses.sa:
वर्चसा मां समनक्त्वग्निर्मेधां मे विष्णुर्न्यनक्त्वासन् ।
रयिं मे विश्वे नि यच्छन्तु देवाः स्योना मापः पवनैः पुनन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
varchasa mam samanaktvagnirmedham me vishnurnyanaktvasan |
rayim me vishve ni yachchhantu devah syona mapah pavanaih punantu ||

verses.sa:
मित्रावरुणा परि मामधातामादित्या मा स्वरवो वर्धयन्तु ।
वर्चो म इन्द्रो न्यनक्तु हस्तयोर्जरदष्टिं मा सविता कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
mitravaruna pari mamadhatamaditya ma svaravo vardhayantu |
varcho ma indro nyanaktu hastayorjaradashtim ma savita krinotu ||

verses.sa:
यो ममार प्रथमो मर्त्यानां यः प्रेयाय प्रथमो लोकमेतम् ।
वैवस्वतं संगमनं जनानां यमं राजानं हविषा सपर्यत ॥
verses.rom:
yo mamara prathamo martyanam yah preyaya prathamo lokametam |
vaivasvatam samgamanam jananam yamam rajanam havisha saparyata ||

verses.sa:
परा यात पितर आ च यातायं वो यज्ञो मधुना समक्तः ।
दत्तो अस्मभ्यं द्रविणेह भद्रं रयिं च नः सर्ववीरं दधात ॥
verses.rom:
para yata pitara a cha yatayam vo yajno madhuna samaktah |
datto asmabhyam dravineha bhadram rayim cha nah sarvaviram dadhata ||

verses.sa:
कण्वः कक्षीवान् पुरुमीढो अगस्त्यः श्यावाश्वः सोभर्यर्चनानाः ।
विश्वामित्रोऽयं जमदग्निरत्रिरवन्तु नः कश्यपो वामदेवः ॥
verses.rom:
kanvah kakshivan purumidho agastyah shyavashvah sobharyarchananah |
vishvamitro'yam jamadagniratriravantu nah kashyapo vamadevah ||

verses.sa:
विश्वामित्र जमदग्ने वसिष्ठ भरद्वाज गोतम वामदेव ।
शर्दिर्नो अत्रिरग्रभीन् नमोभिः सुसंशासः पितरो मृडता नः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvamitra jamadagne vasishtha bharadvaja gotama vamadeva |
shardirno atriragrabhin namobhih susamshasah pitaro mridata nah ||

verses.sa:
कस्ये मृजाना अति यन्ति रिप्रमायुर्दधानाः प्रतरं नवीयः ।
आप्यायमानाः प्रजया धनेनाध स्याम सुरभयो गृहेषु ॥
verses.rom:
kasye mrijana ati yanti ripramayurdadhanah prataram naviyah |
apyayamanah prajaya dhanenadha syama surabhayo griheshu ||

verses.sa:
अञ्जते व्यञ्जते समञ्जते क्रतुं रिहन्ति मधुनाभ्यञ्जते ।
सिन्धोरुच्छ्वासे पतयन्तमुक्षणं हिरण्यपावाः पशुमासु गृह्नते ॥
verses.rom:
anjate vyanjate samanjate kratum rihanti madhunabhyanjate |
sindhoruchchhvase patayantamukshanam hiranyapavah pashumasu grihnate ||

verses.sa:
यद्वो मुद्रं पितरः सोम्यं च तेनो सचध्वं स्वयशसो हि भूत ।
ते अर्वाणः कवय आ शृणोत सुविदत्रा विदथे हुयमानाः ॥
verses.rom:
yadvo mudram pitarah somyam cha teno sachadhvam svayashaso hi bhuta |
te arvanah kavaya a shrinota suvidatra vidathe huyamanah ||

verses.sa:
ये अत्रयो अङ्गिरसो नवग्वा इष्टावन्तो रातिषाचो दधानाः ।
दक्षिणावन्तः सुकृतो य उ स्थासद्यास्मिन् बर्हिषि मादयध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye atrayo angiraso navagva ishtavanto ratishacho dadhanah |
dakshinavantah sukrito ya u sthasadyasmin barhishi madayadhvam ||

verses.sa:
अधा यथा नः पितरः परासः प्रत्नासो अग्न ऋतमाशशानाः ।
शुचीदयन् दीध्यत उक्थशसः क्षामा भिन्दन्तो अरुणीरप व्रन् ॥
verses.rom:
adha yatha nah pitarah parasah pratnaso agna ritamashashanah |
shuchidayan didhyata ukthashasah kshama bhindanto arunirapa vran ||

verses.sa:
सुकर्मानः सुरुचो देवयन्तो अयो न देवा जनिमा धमन्तः ।
शुचन्तो अग्निं वावृधन्त इन्द्रमुर्वीं गव्यां परिषदं नो अक्रन् ॥
verses.rom:
sukarmanah surucho devayanto ayo na deva janima dhamantah |
shuchanto agnim vavridhanta indramurvim gavyam parishadam no akran ||

verses.sa:
आ यूथेव क्षुमति पश्वो अख्यद्देवानां जनिमान्त्युग्रः ।
मर्तासश्चिदुर्वशीरकृप्रन् वृधे चिदर्य उपरस्यायोः ॥
verses.rom:
a yutheva kshumati pashvo akhyaddevanam janimantyugrah |
martasashchidurvashirakripran vridhe chidarya uparasyayoh ||

verses.sa:
अकर्म ते स्वपसो अभूम ऋतमवस्रन्न् उषसो विभातीः ।
विश्वं तद्भद्रं यदवन्ति देवा बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
verses.rom:
akarma te svapaso abhuma ritamavasrann ushaso vibhatih |
vishvam tadbhadram yadavanti deva brihadvadema vidathe suvirah ||

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मा मरुत्वान् प्राच्या दिशः पातु बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
indro ma marutvan prachya dishah patu bahuchyuta prithivi dyamivopari |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||

verses.sa:
धाता मा निर्ऋत्या दक्षिणाया दिशः पातु बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
dhata ma nirritya dakshinaya dishah patu bahuchyuta prithivi dyamivopari |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||

verses.sa:
अदितिर्मादित्यैः प्रतीच्या दिशः पातु बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
aditirmadityaih pratichya dishah patu bahuchyuta prithivi dyamivopari |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||

verses.sa:
सोमो मा विश्वैर्देवैरुदीच्या दिशः पातु बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
somo ma vishvairdevairudichya dishah patu bahuchyuta prithivi dyamivopari |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||

verses.sa:
धर्ता ह त्वा धरुणो धारयाता ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सविता द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
dharta ha tva dharuno dharayata urdhvam bhanum savita dyamivopari |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||

verses.sa:
प्राच्यां त्वा दिशि पुरा सम्वृतः स्वधायामा दधामि बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
prachyam tva dishi pura samvritah svadhayama dadhami bahuchyuta prithivi dyamivopari |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||

verses.sa:
दक्षिणायां त्वा दिशि पुरा सम्वृतः स्वधायामा दधामि बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
dakshinayam tva dishi pura samvritah svadhayama dadhami bahuchyuta prithivi dyamivopari |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||

verses.sa:
प्रतीच्यां त्वा दिशि पुरा संवृतः स्वधायामा दधामि बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
pratichyam tva dishi pura samvritah svadhayama dadhami bahuchyuta prithivi dyamivopari |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||

verses.sa:
उदीच्यां त्वा दिशि पुरा सम्वृतः स्वधायामा दधामि बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
udichyam tva dishi pura samvritah svadhayama dadhami bahuchyuta prithivi dyamivopari |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||

verses.sa:
ध्रुवायां त्वा दिशि पुरा संवृतः स्वधायामा दधामि बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
dhruvayam tva dishi pura samvritah svadhayama dadhami bahuchyuta prithivi dyamivopari |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वायां त्वा दिशि पुरा सम्वृतः स्वधायामा दधामि बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvayam tva dishi pura samvritah svadhayama dadhami bahuchyuta prithivi dyamivopari |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||

verses.sa: धर्तासि धरुनोऽसि वंसगोऽसि ॥
verses.rom: dhartasi dharuno'si vamsago'si ||

verses.sa: उदपूरसि मधुपूरसि वातपूरसि ॥
verses.rom: udapurasi madhupurasi vatapurasi ||

verses.sa:
इतश्च मामुतश्चावतां यमे इव यतमाने यदैतम् ।
प्र वां भरन् मानुषा देवयन्तो आ सीदतां स्वमु लोकं विदाने ॥
verses.rom:
itashcha mamutashchavatam yame iva yatamane yadaitam |
pra vam bharan manusha devayanto a sidatam svamu lokam vidane ||

verses.sa:
स्वासस्थे भवतमिन्दवे नो युजे वां ब्रह्म पूर्व्यं नमोभिः ।
वि श्लोक एति पथ्येव सूरिः शृण्वन्तु विश्वे अमृतास एतत् ॥
verses.rom:
svasasthe bhavatamindave no yuje vam brahma purvyam namobhih |
vi shloka eti pathyeva surih shrinvantu vishve amritasa etat ||

verses.sa:
त्रीणि पदानि रुपो अन्वरोहच्चतुष्पदीमन्वेतद्व्रतेन ।
अक्षरेण प्रति मिमीते अर्कमृतस्य नाभावभि सं पुनाति ॥
verses.rom:
trini padani rupo anvarohachchatushpadimanvetadvratena |
aksharena prati mimite arkamritasya nabhavabhi sam punati ||

verses.sa:
देवेभ्यः कमवृणीत मृत्युं प्रजायै किममृतं नावृणीत ।
बृहस्पतिर्यज्ञमतनुत ऋषिः प्रियां यमस्तन्वमा रिरेच ॥
verses.rom:
devebhyah kamavrinita mrityum prajayai kimamritam navrinita |
brihaspatiryajnamatanuta rishih priyam yamastanvama rirecha ||

verses.sa:
त्वमग्न ईडितो जातवेदोऽवाड्ढव्यानि सुरभीणि कृत्वा ।
प्रादाः पितृभ्यः स्वधया ते अक्षन्न् अद्धि त्वं देव प्रयता हवींषि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagna idito jatavedo'vaddhavyani surabhini kritva |
pradah pitribhyah svadhaya te akshann addhi tvam deva prayata havimshi ||

verses.sa:
आसीनासो अरुणीनामुपस्थे रयिं धत्त दाशुषे मर्त्याय ।
पुत्रेभ्यः पितरस्तस्य वस्वः प्र यच्छत त इहोर्जं दधात ॥
verses.rom:
asinaso aruninamupasthe rayim dhatta dashushe martyaya |
putrebhyah pitarastasya vasvah pra yachchhata ta ihorjam dadhata ||

verses.sa:
अग्निष्वात्ताः पितर एह गच्छत सदःसदः सदत सुप्रणीतयः ।
अत्तो हवींषि प्रयतानि बर्हिषि रयिं च नः सर्ववीरं दधात ॥
verses.rom:
agnishvattah pitara eha gachchhata sadahsadah sadata supranitayah |
atto havimshi prayatani barhishi rayim cha nah sarvaviram dadhata ||

verses.sa:
उपहूता नः पितरः सोम्यासो बर्हिष्येषु निधिषु प्रियेषु ।
त आ गमन्तु त इह श्रुवन्त्वधि ब्रुवन्तु तेऽवन्त्वस्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
upahuta nah pitarah somyaso barhishyeshu nidhishu priyeshu |
ta a gamantu ta iha shruvantvadhi bruvantu te'vantvasman ||

verses.sa:
ये नः पितुः पितरो ये पितामहा अनूजहिरे सोमपीथं वसिष्ठाः ।
तेभिर्यमः सम्रराणो हवींष्युशन्न् उशद्भिः प्रतिकाममत्तु ॥
verses.rom:
ye nah pituh pitaro ye pitamaha anujahire somapitham vasishthah |
tebhiryamah samrarano havimshyushann ushadbhih pratikamamattu ||

verses.sa:
ये तातृषुर्देवत्रा जेहमाना होत्राविदः स्तोमतष्टासो अर्कैः ।
आग्ने याहि सहस्रं देववन्दैः सत्यैः कविभिर्ऋषिभिर्घर्मसद्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
ye tatrishurdevatra jehamana hotravidah stomatashtaso arkaih |
agne yahi sahasram devavandaih satyaih kavibhirrishibhirgharmasadbhih ||

verses.sa:
ये सत्यासो हविरदो हविष्पा इन्द्रेण देवैः सरथं तुरेण ।
आग्ने याहि सुविदत्रेभिरर्वाङ्परैः पूर्वैर्ऋषिभिर्घर्मसद्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
ye satyaso havirado havishpa indrena devaih saratham turena |
agne yahi suvidatrebhirarvanparaih purvairrishibhirgharmasadbhih ||

verses.sa:
उप सर्प मातरं भूमिमेतामुरुव्यचसं पृथिवीं सुशेवाम् ।
ऊर्णम्रदाः पृथिवी दक्षिणावत एषा त्वा पातु प्रपथे पुरस्तात् ॥
verses.rom:
upa sarpa mataram bhumimetamuruvyachasam prithivim sushevam |
urnamradah prithivi dakshinavata esha tva patu prapathe purastat ||

verses.sa:
उच्छ्वञ्चस्व पृथिवि मा नि बाधथाः सूपायनास्मै भव सूपसर्पणा ।
माता पुत्रं यथा सिचाभ्येनं भूम ऊर्णुहि ॥
verses.rom:
uchchhvanchasva prithivi ma ni badhathah supayanasmai bhava supasarpana |
mata putram yatha sichabhyenam bhuma urnuhi ||

verses.sa:
उच्छ्वञ्चमाना पृथिवी सु तिष्ठतु सहस्रं मित उप हि श्रयन्ताम् ।
ते गृहासो घृतश्चुतः स्योना विश्वाहास्मै शरणाः सन्त्वत्र ॥
verses.rom:
uchchhvanchamana prithivi su tishthatu sahasram mita upa hi shrayantam |
te grihaso ghritashchutah syona vishvahasmai sharanah santvatra ||

verses.sa:
उत्ते स्तभ्नामि पृथिवीं त्वत्परीमं लोगं निदधन् मो अहं रिषम् ।
एतां स्थूणां पितरो धारयन्ति ते तत्र यमः सादना ते कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
utte stabhnami prithivim tvatparimam logam nidadhan mo aham risham |
etam sthunam pitaro dharayanti te tatra yamah sadana te krinotu ||

verses.sa:
इममग्ने चमसं मा वि जिह्वरः प्रियो देवानामुत सोम्यानाम् ।
अयं यश्चमसो देवपानस्तस्मिन् देवा अमृता मादयन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
imamagne chamasam ma vi jihvarah priyo devanamuta somyanam |
ayam yashchamaso devapanastasmin deva amrita madayantam ||

verses.sa:
अथर्वा पूर्णं चमसं यमिन्द्रायाबिभर्वाजिनीवते ।
तस्मिन् कृणोति सुकृतस्य भक्षं तस्मिन् इन्दुः पवते विश्वदानीम् ॥
verses.rom:
atharva purnam chamasam yamindrayabibharvajinivate |
tasmin krinoti sukritasya bhaksham tasmin induh pavate vishvadanim ||

verses.sa:
यत्ते कृष्णः शकुन आतुतोद पिपीलः सर्प उत वा श्वापदः ।
अग्निष्टद्विश्वादगदं कृणोतु सोमश्च यो ब्राह्मणामाविवेश ॥
verses.rom:
yatte krishnah shakuna atutoda pipilah sarpa uta va shvapadah |
agnishtadvishvadagadam krinotu somashcha yo brahmanamavivesha ||

verses.sa:
पयस्वतीरोषधयः पयस्वन् मामकं पयः ।
अपां पयसो यत्पयस्तेन मा सह शुम्भतु ॥
verses.rom:
payasvatiroshadhayah payasvan mamakam payah |
apam payaso yatpayastena ma saha shumbhatu ||

verses.sa:
इमा नारीरविधवाः सुपत्नीराञ्जनेन सर्पिषा सं स्पृशन्ताम् ।
अनश्रवो अनमीवाः सुरत्ना आ रोहन्तु जनयो योनिमग्रे ॥
verses.rom:
ima nariravidhavah supatniranjanena sarpisha sam sprishantam |
anashravo anamivah suratna a rohantu janayo yonimagre ||

verses.sa:
सं गच्छस्व पितृभिः सं यमेनेष्टापूर्तेन परमे व्योमन् ।
हित्वावद्यं पुनरस्तमेहि सं गच्छतां तन्वा सुवर्चाः ॥
verses.rom:
sam gachchhasva pitribhih sam yameneshtapurtena parame vyoman |
hitvavadyam punarastamehi sam gachchhatam tanva suvarchah ||

verses.sa:
ये नः पितुः पितरो ये पितामहा य आविविशुरुर्वन्तरिक्षम् ।
तेभ्यः स्वरादसुनीतिर्नो अद्य वथावशं तन्वः कल्पयाति ॥
verses.rom:
ye nah pituh pitaro ye pitamaha ya avivishururvantariksham |
tebhyah svaradasunitirno adya vathavasham tanvah kalpayati ||

verses.sa:
शं ते नीहारो भवतु शं ते प्रुष्वाव शीयताम् ।
शीतिके शीतिकावति ह्लादिके ह्लादिकावति ।
मण्डूक्यप्सु शं भुव इमं स्वग्निं शमय ॥
verses.rom:
sham te niharo bhavatu sham te prushvava shiyatam |
shitike shitikavati hladike hladikavati |
mandukyapsu sham bhuva imam svagnim shamaya ||

verses.sa:
विवस्वान् नो अभयं कृणोतु यः सुत्रामा जीरदानुः सुदानुः ।
इहेमे वीरा बहवो भवन्तु गोमदश्ववन् मय्यस्तु पुष्टम् ॥
verses.rom:
vivasvan no abhayam krinotu yah sutrama jiradanuh sudanuh |
iheme vira bahavo bhavantu gomadashvavan mayyastu pushtam ||

verses.sa:
विवस्वान् नो अमृतत्वे दधातु परैतु मृत्युरमृतं न ऐतु ।
इमान् रक्षतु पुरुषान् आ जरिम्णो मो स्वेषामसवो यमं गुः ॥
verses.rom:
vivasvan no amritatve dadhatu paraitu mrityuramritam na aitu |
iman rakshatu purushan a jarimno mo sveshamasavo yamam guh ||

verses.sa:
यो दध्रे अन्तरिक्षे न मह्ना पितॄणां कविः प्रमतिर्मतीनाम् ।
तमर्चत विश्वमित्रा हविर्भिः स नो यमः प्रतरं जीवसे धात् ॥
verses.rom:
yo dadhre antarikshe na mahna pitrinam kavih pramatirmatinam |
tamarchata vishvamitra havirbhih sa no yamah prataram jivase dhat ||

verses.sa:
आ रोहत दिवमुत्तमामृषयो मा बिभीतन ।
सोमपाः सोमपायिन इदं वः क्रियते हविरगन्म ज्योतिरुत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
a rohata divamuttamamrishayo ma bibhitana |
somapah somapayina idam vah kriyate haviraganma jyotiruttamam ||

verses.sa:
प्र केतुना बृहता भात्यग्निरा रोदसी वृषभो रोरवीति ।
दिवश्चिदन्तादुपमामुदानडपामुपस्थे महिषो ववर्ध ॥
verses.rom:
pra ketuna brihata bhatyagnira rodasi vrishabho roraviti |
divashchidantadupamamudanadapamupasthe mahisho vavardha ||

verses.sa:
नाके सुपर्णमुप यत्पतन्तं ह्र्दा वेनन्तो अभ्यचक्षत त्वा ।
हिरण्यपक्षं वरुणस्य दूतं यमस्य योनौ शकुनं भुरन्युम् ॥
verses.rom:
nake suparnamupa yatpatantam hrda venanto abhyachakshata tva |
hiranyapaksham varunasya dutam yamasya yonau shakunam bhuranyum ||

verses.sa:
इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा ।
शिक्षा णो अस्मिन् पुरुहूत यामनि जीवा ज्योतिरशीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
indra kratum na a bhara pita putrebhyo yatha |
shiksha no asmin puruhuta yamani jiva jyotirashimahi ||

verses.sa:
अपूपापिहितान् कुम्भान् यांस्ते देवा अधारयन् ।
ते ते सन्तु स्वधावन्तो मधुमन्तो घृतश्चुतः ॥
verses.rom:
apupapihitan kumbhan yamste deva adharayan |
te te santu svadhavanto madhumanto ghritashchutah ||

verses.sa:
यास्ते धाना अनुकिरामि तिलमिश्रा स्वधावतीः ।
तास्ते सन्तु विभ्वीः प्रभ्वीस्तास्ते यमो राजानु मन्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yaste dhana anukirami tilamishra svadhavatih |
taste santu vibhvih prabhvistaste yamo rajanu manyatam ||

verses.sa:
पुनर्देहि वनस्पते य एष निहितस्त्वयि ।
यथा यमस्य सादन आसातौ विदथा वदन् ॥
verses.rom:
punardehi vanaspate ya esha nihitastvayi |
yatha yamasya sadana asatau vidatha vadan ||

verses.sa:
आ रभस्व जातवेदस्तेजस्वद्धरो अस्तु ते ।
शरीरमस्य सं दहाथैनं देहि सुकृतामु लोके ॥
verses.rom:
a rabhasva jatavedastejasvaddharo astu te |
shariramasya sam dahathainam dehi sukritamu loke ||

verses.sa:
ये ते पूर्वे परागता अपरे पितरश्च ये ।
तेभ्यो घृतस्य कुल्यैतु शतधारा व्युन्दती ॥
verses.rom:
ye te purve paragata apare pitarashcha ye |
tebhyo ghritasya kulyaitu shatadhara vyundati ||

verses.sa:
एतदा रोह वय उन्मृजानः स्वा इह बृहदु दीदयन्ते ।
अभि प्रेहि मध्यतो माप हास्थाः पितॄनां लोकं प्रथमो यो अत्र ॥
verses.rom:
etada roha vaya unmrijanah sva iha brihadu didayante |
abhi prehi madhyato mapa hasthah pitrinam lokam prathamo yo atra ||

prose.en:
1. This woman, choosing her husband's world, lies down (ni-pad) by thee that art departed, O mortal, continuing to keep [her] ancient duty (dhárma); to her assign thou here progeny and property.

2. Go up, O woman, to the world of the living; thou liest by (upa-çī) this one who is deceased: come! to him who grasps thy hand, thy second spouse (didhiṣú), thou hast now entered into the relation of wife to husband.

3. I saw the maiden being led, being led about, alive, for the dead; as she was enclosed with blind darkness, then I led her off-ward (ápācī) from in front (prāktás).

4. Foreknowing, O inviolable one, the world of the living, moving together [with him] upon the road of the gods—this is thy herdsman (gópati); enjoy him; make him ascend to the heavenly (svargá) world.

5. Unto sky (div), unto reed, more helpful of streams; O Agni, gall of the waters art thou.

6. Whom thou, O Agni, didst consume, him do thou extinguish again;, let there grow here the kyā́mbū, the çāṇḍadūrvā́, the vyàlkaçā.

7. Here is one for thee, beyond is one for thee; enter thou into union with the third light; at entrance be thou fair (cā́ru) with [thy] body, loved of the gods in the highest station.

8. Rise thou, go forth, run forth; make thee a home (ókas) in the sea [as] station; there do thou, in concord with the Fathers, revel with soma, with the svadhā́s.

9. Start (cyu) forward, collect (sam-bhṛ) thy body; let not thy limbs (gā́tra) nor thy frame (çárīra) be left out; enter together after thy mind that has entered; wherever in the world thou enjoyest, thither go.

10. Let the soma-drinking (somyá) Fathers anoint me with splendor, the gods with honey, with ghee; making me pass further on unto sight, let them increase me, attaining old age, unto old age.

11. Let Agni anoint me completely with splendor; let Vishṇu anoint wisdom into my mouth; let all the gods fix wealth upon me; let pleasant waters purify me with purifiers.

12. Mitra-and-Varuṇa have enclosed (pari-dhā) me; let the sacrificial posts of Aditi increase me; let Indra anoint splendor into my hands; let Savitar make me one attaining old age.

13. Him who died first of mortals, who went forth first to that world, Vivasvant's son, assembler of people, king Yama honor ye with oblation.

14. Go away, ye Fathers, and come; this sacrifice is all anointed with honey for you; both give to us here excellent property, and assign to us wealth having all heroes.

15. Let Kaṇva, Kakshīvant, Purumīḍha, Agastya, Çyāvāçva, Sobharī, Archanānas, Viçvāmitra, Jamadagni here, Atri, Kaçyapa, Vāmadeva, aid us.

16. O Viçvāmitra, Jamadagni, Vasishṭha, Bharadvāja, Gotama, Vāmadeva—Atri hath taken (grabh) our çardís with obeisances; ye Fathers of good report, be gracious to us.

17. They overpass defilement (riprá), wiping [it] off in the metal bowl (? kasyá), assuming further on newer life-time, filling themselves up with progeny and riches; then may we be of good odor in the houses.

18. They anoint, they anoint out (ví), they anoint together (sám); they lick the rite (? krátu), they smear (abhi-añj) with honey; the bull (ukṣán) flying in the upheaving of the river, the victim (paçú) do the gold-purifiers seize (gṛh) in them f..

19. What of you is joyous, O Fathers, and delectable (somyá), therewith be at hand (sac), for ye are of own splendor; do ye, rapid (? árvan) poets, listen, beneficent, invoked at the council.

20. Ye who are Atris, An̄girases, Navagvas, having sacrificed, attached to giving (? rātiṣā́c), bestowers (dádhāna), and who are rich in sacrificial fees, well-doing—do ye revel, sitting on this barhís.

21. So then as our distant Fathers, the ancient ones, O Agni, sharpening the rite: they went to the bright, they shone,* should be shining, praising with song; splitting the ground, they uncovered the ruddy ones.

22. Of good actions, well-shining, pious, heavenly ones (devá), forging the generations as [smiths forge] metal, brightening Agni, increasing Indra, they have made for us a wide conclave (pariṣád), rich in kine.

23. As herds at food (kṣúm), the formidable one hath looked over áti the cattle, the births of the gods, near by; mortals have lamented the urváçīs, unto the increase of the pious, of the next man.

24. We have made [sacrifices] for thee; we have been very active; the illuminating (vi-bhā) dawns have shone upon [our] rite (ṛtá); all that is excellent which the gods favor; may we talk big at the council, having good heroes.

25. Let Indra with the Maruts protect me from the eastern quarter; arm-moved [is] the earth, as it were to the sky above; to the world-makers, the road-makers, do we sacrifice, whoever of you are here, sharing in the oblation of the gods.

26. Let Dhātar protect me from perdition from the southern quarter; arm-moved etc. etc.

27. Let Aditi with the Ādityas protect me from the western quarter; arm-moved etc. etc.

28. Let Soma with all the gods protect me from the northern quarter; arm-moved etc. etc.

29. Dhartar the maintainer shall maintain thee aloft, as Savitar the light (bhānú) to the sky above; to the world-makers etc. etc.

30. In the eastern quarter, away from approach (?), do I set thee in svadhā́; arm-moved etc. etc.

31. In the southern quarter, away etc. etc.

32. In the western quarter, away etc. etc.

33. In the northern quarter, away etc. etc.

34. In the fixed quarter, away etc. etc.

35. In the upward quarter, away etc. etc.

36. Dhartar ('maintainer') art thou; maintaining art thou; bull (váṅsaga) art thou.

37. Water-purifying art thou; honey-purifying art thou; wind-purifying art thou.

38. Both from here and from yonder let them (du.) aid me.

39. Be ye comfortable (? svā́sastha) for our soma.

40. Three steps the form (?) ascended, it went (?) after the four-footed one (f.) with its course (vratá); it matches the song (arká) with the syllable; in the navel of right it purifies.

41. For the gods he chose death; for his progeny did he not choose immortality (amṛ́ta)? Brihaspati [as] seer extended the sacrifice; Yama left (ā-ric) his dear self (?).

42. Thou, O Agni, Jātavedas, being praised, hast carried the offerings, having made them fragrant; thou hast given to the Fathers; they have eaten after their wont (? svadháyā); eat thou, O god, the presented oblations.

43. Sitting in the lap of the ruddy ones (f.), assign ye wealth to your mortal worshiper (dāçvā́ṅs); of that good, O Fathers, present ye to your sons; do ye bestow (dhā) refreshment here.

44. Ye fire-sweetened Fathers, come hither; sit on each seat, well-conducting ones; eat on the barhís the presented oblations, and assign to us wealth having all heroes.

45. Called unto [are] our delectable (somyá) Fathers, to dear deposits on the barhís; let them come; let them listen here; let them bless, let them aid us.

46. They who, our father's fathers, who [his] grandfathers, followed after (? anu-hā) the soma-drinking, best ones—with them let Yama, sharing his gift of oblations, he eager with them eager, eat at pleasure.

47. They who thirsted panting among the gods, knowers of offering, praise-fashioned, with songs (arká)—come, O Agni, with the thousand god-revering true poets, seers sitting at the gharmá.

48. The true, oblation-eating, oblation-drinking ones, that [go] in alliance (sarátham) with the gods, with strong (turá) Indra—come hitherward, O Agni, with the beneficent, exalted (pára), ancient seers, sitting at the gharmá.

49. Approach (upa-sṛp) thou this mother earth (bhū́mi), the wide-expanded earth (pṛthivī́), the very propitious; the earth (pṛthivī́) [is] soft as wool to him who has sacrificial gifts; let her protect thee on the forward road in front.

50. Swell thou up, O earth; do not press down; be to him easy of access, easy of approach; as a mother her son with her skirt (síc), do thou, O earth (bhū́mi), cover him.

51. Let the earth kindly remain swelling up, for let a thousand props support (upa-çri) it; let these houses, dripping with ghee, pleasant, be forever a refuge for him there (átra).

52. I brace up (ut-stabh) the earth from about thee; setting down this clod (? logá), let me take no harm; this pillar do the Fathers maintain for thee; let Yama there make seats for thee.

53. This bowl, O Agni, do not warp (vi-hvṛ); [it is] dear to the gods and the delectable [Fathers]; this bowl here for the gods to drink from—in it let the immortal gods revel.

54. The bowl that Atharvan bore full to Indra the vigorous, in that he makes a draught of what is well done; in that, soma (índu) ever purifies itself.

55. What of thee the black bird (çakuná) thrust at, the ant, the serpent, or also the beast of prey (çvā́pada), let the all-eating viçva-ád Agni make that free from disease, and the soma that hath entered the Brahmans.

56. Rich in milk are the herbs; rich in milk is my milk; what is the milk of the milk of the waters, therewith let one beautify (çubh) me.

57. Let these women, not widows, well-spoused, touch themselves with ointment, with butter; tearless, without disease, with good treasures, let the wives ascend first to the place of union.

58. Unite thyself (sam-gam) with the Fathers, with Yama, with thy sacred and charitable works in the highest firmament; abandoning what is reproachful, come again home;—let him unite himself with a body, very splendid.

59. They that are our father's fathers, that are [his] grandfathers, that entered the wide atmosphere—for them may the autocratic (svarā́j) second life today shape our bodies as he will.

60. Let the mist be weal for thee; let the frost fall down [as] weal for thee; O cool one, possessing cool ones; O refreshing one, possessing refreshing ones; mayest thou be with weal a she-frog in the waters; kindly pacify thou this fire.

61. Let Vivasvant make for us freedom from fear, he who is well-preserving, quick-giving (? -dā́nu), well-giving; let these heroes be many here; let there be in me prosperity (puṣṭá) rich in kine, rich in horses.
