62. Let Vivasvant set us in immortality; let death go away; let what is immortal come to us; let [him] defend these men until old age; let not their life-breaths (ásu) go to Yama.

64. Ascend ye to the highest heaven; O seers, be not afraid; ye soma-drinkers, soma-drenchers, this oblation is made to you; we have gone to the highest light.

65. Agni shines forth with great show (ketú); the bull roars loudly unto the two firmaments (ródasī); even from the end of heaven he hath attained unto me (?); in the lap of the waters the buffalo increased.

66. As, longing with the heart, they looked upon thee, flying up* [as] an eagle in the firmament (nā́ka), golden-winged messenger of Varuṇa, busy (bhuraṇyú) bird (çakuná) in the lair of Yama.

67. O Indra, bring us ability (krátu), as a father to his sons; help (çikṣ) us in this course (yā́man), O much-invoked one; may we, living, attain to light.

68. What vessels covered (api-dhā) with cakes the gods maintained for thee, be they for thee rich in svadhā́, rich in honey, dripping with ghee.

69. What grains I scatter along for thee, mixed with sesame, rich in svadhā́, be they for thee abundant (vibhú), prevailing; them let king Yama approve for thee.

70. Give back, O forest tree, him who is deposited here with thee, that in Yama's seat he may sit speaking counsels.

71. Take hold, O Jātavedas; let thy seizure (háras) be with sharpness (téjas-); his body do thou consume; then set him in the world of the well-doing.

72. What Fathers of thine went away earlier and what later, for them let there go a brook of ghee, hundred-streamed, overflowing.

73. Ascend thou this, gaining (ud-mṛj) vigor (váyas); thine own [people] shine here greatly; go forth, unto [them],—be not left behind midway—unto the world of the Fathers that is first there.

verses.sa:
आ रोहत जनित्रीं जातवेदसः पितृयानैः सं व आ रोहयामि ।
अवाड्ढव्येषितो हव्यवाह ईजानं युक्ताः सुकृतां धत्त लोके ॥
verses.rom:
a rohata janitrim jatavedasah pitriyanaih sam va a rohayami |
avaddhavyeshito havyavaha ijanam yuktah sukritam dhatta loke ||
verses.en: Ascend to [your] generatrix, ye Jātavedases; by [roads] that the Fathers travel I make you ascend together; the offering-carrier, sent out, hath carried the offerings; united (yuktá), set ye him who hath sacrificed in the world of the well-doing.

verses.sa:
देवा यज्ञमृतवः कल्पयन्ति हविः पुरोडाशं स्रुचो यज्ञायुधानि ।
तेभिर्याहि पथिभिर्देवयानैर्यैरीजानाः स्वर्गं यन्ति लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
deva yajnamritavah kalpayanti havih purodasham srucho yajnayudhani |
tebhiryahi pathibhirdevayanairyairijanah svargam yanti lokam ||
verses.en: The gods, the seasons, arrange the sacrifice, the oblation, the sacrificial cake, the ladles (srúc), the implements (-ā́yudha) of sacrifice; with them go thou by roads that the gods travel, by which they that have sacrificed go to the heavenly (svargá) world.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य पन्थामनु पश्य साध्वङ्गिरसः सुकृतो येन यन्ति ।
तेभिर्याहि पथिभिः स्वर्गं यत्रादित्या मधु भक्षयन्ति तृतीये नाके अधि वि श्रयस्व ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya panthamanu pashya sadhvangirasah sukrito yena yanti |
tebhiryahi pathibhih svargam yatraditya madhu bhakshayanti tritiye nake adhi vi shrayasva ||
verses.en: Look thou happily (sādhú) along the road of righteousness, by which go the An̄girases, well-doers; by those roads go thou to heaven (svargá), where the Ādityas feed on honey; spread thou out upon the third firmament.

verses.sa:
त्रयः सुपर्णा उपरस्य मायू नाकस्य पृष्ठे अधि विष्टपि श्रिताः ।
स्वर्गा लोका अमृतेन विष्ठा इषमूर्जं यजमानाय दुह्राम् ॥
verses.rom:
trayah suparna uparasya mayu nakasya prishthe adhi vishtapi shritah |
svarga loka amritena vishtha ishamurjam yajamanaya duhram ||
verses.en: Three eagles (suparṇá)...upon the back of the firmament (nā́ka), at the summit (? viṣṭáp) are set (çritá); let the heavenly (svargá) worlds, filled (?) with amṛ́ta, yield (duh) food, refreshment to the sacrificer.

verses.sa:
जुहूर्दाधार द्यामुपभृदन्तरिक्षं ध्रुवा दाधार पृथिवीं प्रतिष्ठाम् ।
ध्रुव आ रोह पृथिवीं विश्वभोजसमन्तरिक्षमुपभृदा क्रमस्व ।
प्रतीमां लोका घृतपृष्ठाः स्वर्गाः कामंकामं यजमानाय दुह्राम् ॥
verses.rom:
juhurdadhara dyamupabhridantariksham dhruva dadhara prithivim pratishtham |
dhruva a roha prithivim vishvabhojasamantarikshamupabhrida kramasva |
pratimam loka ghritaprishthah svargah kamamkamam yajamanaya duhram ||
verses.en: The sacrificial spoon (juhū́) sustains the sky, the offering spoon (upabhṛ́t) the atmosphere; the ladle (dhruvā́) sustains dhṛ the earth, the support (pratiṣṭhā́); unto me (?) let the worlds, ghee-backed, heavenly (svargá), yield every desire for the sacrificer.

verses.sa:
ध्रुव आ रोह पृथिवीं विश्वभोजसमन्तरिक्षमुपभृदा क्रमस्व ।
जुहु द्यां गच्छ यजमानेन साकं स्रुवेण वत्सेन दिशः प्रपीनाः सर्वा धुक्ष्वाहृण्यमानः ॥
verses.rom:
dhruva a roha prithivim vishvabhojasamantarikshamupabhrida kramasva |
juhu dyam gachchha yajamanena sakam sruvena vatsena dishah prapinah sarva dhukshvahrinyamanah ||
verses.en: O ladle, ascend the all-nourishing earth; stride, O offering spoon, unto the atmosphere; O sacrificial spoon, go to the sky (dív) in company with the sacrificer; with the little spoon (sruvá) [as] calf, milk thou all the teeming, unirritated quarters.

verses.sa:
तीर्थैस्तरन्ति प्रवतो महीरिति यज्ञकृतः सुकृतो येन यन्ति ।
अत्रादधुर्यजमानाय लोकं दिशो भूतानि यदकल्पयन्त ॥
verses.rom:
tirthaistaranti pravato mahiriti yajnakritah sukrito yena yanti |
atradadhuryajamanaya lokam disho bhutani yadakalpayanta ||
verses.en: By fords they cross the advances (pravát) called the great ones, by what [road] the sacrifice-makers, the well-doers, go; there did they set a world for the sacrificer, when they arranged the quarters, the creatures (bhūtá).

verses.sa:
अङ्गिरसामयनं पूर्वो अग्निरादित्यानामयनं गार्हपत्यो दक्षिणानामयनं दक्षिणाग्निः ।
महिमानमग्नेर्विहितस्य ब्रह्मणा समङ्गः सर्व उप याहि शग्मः ॥
verses.rom:
angirasamayanam purvo agniradityanamayanam garhapatyo dakshinanamayanam dakshinagnih |
mahimanamagnervihitasya brahmana samangah sarva upa yahi shagmah ||
verses.en: The track (áyana) of the An̄girases is the eastern fire; the Ādityas' track is the householder's fire; the track of the sacrificial gifts is the southern fire; do thou, with thy limbs, whole (sárva), powerful (? çagmá), go unto the greatness of Agni [as] disposed by bráhman.

verses.sa:
पूर्वो अग्निष्ट्वा तपतु शं पुरस्ताच्छं पश्चात्तपतु गार्हपत्यः ।
दक्षिणाग्निष्टे तपतु शर्म वर्मोत्तरतो मध्यतो अन्तरिक्षाद्दिशोदिशो अग्ने परि पाहि घोरात् ॥
verses.rom:
purvo agnishtva tapatu sham purastachchham pashchattapatu garhapatyah |
dakshinagnishte tapatu sharma varmottarato madhyato antarikshaddishodisho agne pari pahi ghorat ||
verses.en: Let the eastern fire burn (tap) thee happily (çám) in front; let the householder's fire burn happily behind; let the southern fire burn refuge, defense for thee; from the north, from the midst, from the atmosphere, from each quarter, O Agni, protect him round about from what is terrible.

verses.sa:
यूयमग्ने शंतमाभिस्तनूभिरीजानमभि लोकं स्वर्गम् ।
अश्वा भूत्वा पृष्टिवाहो वहाथ यत्र देवैः सधमादं मदन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
yuyamagne shamtamabhistanubhirijanamabhi lokam svargam |
ashva bhutva prishtivaho vahatha yatra devaih sadhamadam madanti ||
verses.en: Ye, O Agni, having become back-carrying (? pṛṣṭiváh) horses, shall with most healthful forms (tanū́) carry him that has sacrificed unto the heavenly (svargá) world, where they revel in common revelry with the gods.

verses.sa:
शमग्ने पश्चात्तप शं पुरस्ताच्छमुत्तराच्छमधरात्तपैनम् ।
एकस्त्रेधा विहितो जातवेदः सम्यगेनं धेहि सुकृतामु लोके ॥
verses.rom:
shamagne pashchattapa sham purastachchhamuttarachchhamadharattapainam |
ekastredha vihito jatavedah samyagenam dhehi sukritamu loke ||
verses.en: Burn (tap), O Agni, happily behind, happily in front; burn him happily above, happily below; being one, O Jātavedas, triply disposed, set him collectedly (samyák) in the world of the well-doers.

verses.sa:
शमग्नयः समिद्धा आ रभन्तां प्राजापत्यं मेध्यं जातवेदसः ।
शृतं कृण्वन्त इह माव चिक्षिपन् ॥
verses.rom:
shamagnayah samiddha a rabhantam prajapatyam medhyam jatavedasah |
shritam krinvanta iha mava chikshipan ||
verses.en: Let the fires, kindled, take hold happily; let the Jātavedases, making done (çṛtá) here him that is Prajāpati's [and] sacrificial, not throw him down.

verses.sa:
यज्ञ एति विततः कल्पमान ईजानमभि लोकं स्वर्गम् ।
तमग्नयः सर्वहुतं जुषन्तां प्राजापत्यं मेध्यं जातवेदसः ॥
verses.rom:
yajna eti vitatah kalpamana ijanamabhi lokam svargam |
tamagnayah sarvahutam jushantam prajapatyam medhyam jatavedasah ||
verses.en: The sacrifice goes, extended, adapting itself (? kḷp), [taking] him who hath sacrificed, unto the heavenly (svargá) world; let the fires enjoy it, made a whole oblation; let the Jātavedases, making done here him that is Prajāpati's [and] sacrificial, not throw him down.

verses.sa:
ईजानश्चितमारुक्षदग्निं नाकस्य पृष्ठाद्दिवमुत्पतिष्यन् ।
तस्मै प्र भाति नभसो ज्योतिषीमान्त्स्वर्गः पन्थाः सुकृते देवयानः ॥
verses.rom:
ijanashchitamarukshadagnim nakasya prishthaddivamutpatishyan |
tasmai pra bhati nabhaso jyotishimantsvargah panthah sukrite devayanah ||
verses.en: He that hath sacrificed hath ascended the piled fire, about to fly up to heaven (dív) from the back of the firmament (nā́ka); for him, the well-doer, shines forth from the welkin (nábhas), full of light, the heavenly road, traveled by the gods.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्होताध्वर्युष्टे बृहस्पतिरिन्द्रो ब्रह्मा दक्षिणतस्ते अस्तु ।
हुतोऽयं संस्थितो यज्ञ एति यत्र पूर्वमयनं हुतानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirhotadhvaryushte brihaspatirindro brahma dakshinataste astu |
huto'yam samsthito yajna eti yatra purvamayanam hutanam ||
verses.en: Agni thine invoker, Brihaspati thine officiating priest, be Indra on the right thy supervising priest (brahmán); this offered sacrifice, being completed (sáṁsthita), goeth where is the ancient track of those offered.

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् क्षीरवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
apupavan kshiravamshcharureha sidatu |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||
verses.en: Rich in cakes, rich in milk (kṣīrá-) let the dish (carú) take seat here; to the world-makers, the road-makers, do we sacrifice, whoever of you are here, sharing in the oblation of the gods.

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् दधिवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
apupavan dadhivamshcharureha sidatu |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||
verses.en: Rich in cakes, rich in curds (dádhi-), let the dish etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् द्रप्सवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
apupavan drapsavamshcharureha sidatu |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||
verses.en: Rich in cakes, rich in drops (drapsá-), let the dish etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् घृतवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
apupavan ghritavamshcharureha sidatu |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||
verses.en: Rich in cakes, rich in ghee, let the dish etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् मांसवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
apupavan mamsavamshcharureha sidatu |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||
verses.en: Rich in cakes, rich in flesh (māṅsá-), let the dish etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् अन्नवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
apupavan annavamshcharureha sidatu |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||
verses.en: Rich in cakes, rich in food, let the dish etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् मधुमांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
apupavan madhumamshcharureha sidatu |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||
verses.en: Rich in cakes, rich in honey, let the dish etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् रसवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
apupavan rasavamshcharureha sidatu |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||
verses.en: Rich in cakes, rich in sap, let the dish etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् अपवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ ॥
verses.rom:
apupavan apavamshcharureha sidatu |
lokakritah pathikrito yajamahe ye devanam hutabhaga iha stha ||
verses.en: Rich in cakes, rich in water (ápa-), let the dish etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अपूपापिहितान् कुम्भान् यांस्ते देवा अधारयन् ।
ते ते सन्तु स्वधावन्तो मधुमन्तो घृतश्चुतः ॥
verses.rom:
apupapihitan kumbhan yamste deva adharayan |
te te santu svadhavanto madhumanto ghritashchutah ||
verses.en: What vessels covered with cakes the gods maintained for thee, be they for thee rich in svadhā́, rich in honey, dripping with ghee.

verses.sa:
यास्ते धाना अनुकिरामि तिलमिश्राः स्वधावतीः ।
तास्ते सन्तूद्भ्वीः प्रभ्वीस्तास्ते यमो राजानु मन्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yaste dhana anukirami tilamishrah svadhavatih |
taste santudbhvih prabhvistaste yamo rajanu manyatam ||
verses.en: What grains I scatter along for thee, mixed with sesame, rich in svadhā́, be they for thee uprising (udbhú), prevailing; them let king Yama approve for thee.

verses.sa: अक्षितिं भूयसीम् ॥
verses.rom: akshitim bhuyasim ||
verses.en: A more abundant inexhaustibleness.

verses.sa:
द्रप्सश्चस्कन्द पृथिवीमनु द्यामिमं च योनिमनु यश्च पूर्वः ।
समानं योनिमनु संचरन्तं द्रप्सं जुहोम्यनु सप्त होत्राः ॥
verses.rom:
drapsashchaskanda prithivimanu dyamimam cha yonimanu yashcha purvah |
samanam yonimanu samcharantam drapsam juhomyanu sapta hotrah ||
verses.en: The drop leaped (skand) toward the earth, the sky (dív), toward both this lair (yóni) and the one that was of old; of the drop that goes about toward the same lair do I make oblation, after seven invocations (hótrā).

verses.sa:
शतधारं वायुमर्कं स्वर्विदं नृचक्षसस्ते अभि चक्षते रयिम् ।
ये पृनन्ति प्र च यच्छन्ति सर्वदा ते दुह्रते दक्षिणां सप्तमातरम् ॥
verses.rom:
shatadharam vayumarkam svarvidam nrichakshasaste abhi chakshate rayim |
ye prinanti pra cha yachchhanti sarvada te duhrate dakshinam saptamataram ||
verses.en: A hundred-streamed Vāyu, a heaven-finding sun (? arká), wealth, do those men-beholders look upon; whoso bestow (pṛ) and present (prayam) always, they milk a sacrificial gift having seven mothers.

verses.sa:
कोशं दुहन्ति कलशं चतुर्बिलमिडां धेनुं मधुमतीं स्वस्तये ।
ऊर्जं मदन्तीमदितिं जनेष्वग्ने मा हिंसीः परमे व्योमन् ॥
verses.rom:
kosham duhanti kalasham chaturbilamidam dhenum madhumatim svastaye |
urjam madantimaditim janeshvagne ma himsih parame vyoman ||
verses.en: They milk a receptacle (kóça), a jar with four orifices, iḍā [as] milch-cow rich in honey, in order to well-being; reveling refreshment, Aditi among the people, injure thou not, O Agni, in the highest firmament (vyòman).

verses.sa:
एतत्ते देवः सविता वासो ददाति भर्तवे ।
तत्त्वं यमस्य राज्ये वसानस्तार्प्यं चर ॥
verses.rom:
etatte devah savita vaso dadati bhartave |
tattvam yamasya rajye vasanastarpyam chara ||
verses.en: This garment god Savitar gives thee to wear (bhṛ); putting on that, which is tārpyà, do thou go about in Yama's realm.

verses.sa:
धाना धेनुरभवद्वत्सो अस्यास्तिलोऽभवत्।
तां वै यमस्य राज्ये अक्षितामुप जीवति ॥
verses.rom:
dhana dhenurabhavadvatso asyastilo'bhavat|
tam vai yamasya rajye akshitamupa jivati ||
verses.en: The grains became a milch-cow; the sesame became her calf; upon her, unexhausted, one lives in Yama's realm.

verses.sa:
एतास्ते असौ धेनवः कामदुघा भवन्तु ।
एनीः श्येनीः सरूपा विरूपास्तिलवत्सा उप तिष्ठन्तु त्वात्र ॥
verses.rom:
etaste asau dhenavah kamadugha bhavantu |
enih shyenih sarupa virupastilavatsa upa tishthantu tvatra ||
verses.en: Be these, O so-and-so, thy milch-kine that yield what is desired; variegated, white, of like form, of different form, with sesame as calf, let them wait upon (upa-sthā) thee there.

verses.sa:
एनीर्धाना हरिणीः श्येनीरस्य कृष्णा धाना रोहिणीर्धेनवस्ते ।
तिलवत्सा ऊर्जमस्मै दुहाना विश्वाहा सन्त्वनपस्फुरन्तीः ॥
verses.rom:
enirdhana harinih shyenirasya krishna dhana rohinirdhenavaste |
tilavatsa urjamasmai duhana vishvaha santvanapasphurantih ||
verses.en: Grains variegated, yellow, white, grains black, red, [be] thy milch-kine here; with sesame as calf, yielding (duh) him refreshment, be they ever unresisting.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरे हविरिदं जुहोमि साहस्रं शतधारमुत्सम् ।
स बिभर्ति पितरं पितामहान् प्रपितामहान् बिभर्ति पिन्वमानः ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanare haviridam juhomi sahasram shatadharamutsam |
sa bibharti pitaram pitamahan prapitamahan bibharti pinvamanah ||
verses.en: In Vāiçvānara I offer this oblation, a thousand-fold, hundred-streamed fountain (útsa); it supports (bhṛ) [our] father, grandfathers; [our] great-grandfathers it supports, swelling.

verses.sa:
सहस्रधारं शतधारमुत्समक्षितं व्यच्यमानं सलिलस्य पृष्ठे ।
ऊर्जं दुहानमनपस्फुरन्तमुपासते पितरः स्वधाभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sahasradharam shatadharamutsamakshitam vyachyamanam salilasya prishthe |
urjam duhanamanapasphurantamupasate pitarah svadhabhih ||
verses.en: A thousand-streamed, hundred-streamed fountain, unexhausted, expanded upon the back of the sea, yielding refreshment, unresisting, do the Fathers wait on at their will (? svadhā́bhis).

verses.sa:
इदं कसाम्बु चयनेन चितं तत्सजाता अव पश्यतेत ।
मर्त्योऽयममृतत्वमेति तस्मै गृहान् कृणुत यावत्सबन्धु ॥
verses.rom:
idam kasambu chayanena chitam tatsajata ava pashyateta |
martyo'yamamritatvameti tasmai grihan krinuta yavatsabandhu ||
verses.en: This funeral pile (? kásāmbu) [is] piled with piling; come, ye [his] fellows, look down at it; this mortal goeth to immortality; make ye houses for him according to his kindred.

verses.sa:
इहैवैधि धनसनिरिहचित्त इहक्रतुः ।
इहैधि वीर्यवत्तरो वयोधा अपराहतः ॥
verses.rom:
ihaivaidhi dhanasanirihachitta ihakratuh |
ihaidhi viryavattaro vayodha aparahatah ||
verses.en: Be thou just here, winning riches, with thought here, with ability here; be thou here, very heroic, vigor-bestowing, not smitten away.

verses.sa:
पुत्रं पौत्रमभितर्पयन्तीरापो मधुमतीरिमाः ।
स्वधां पितृभ्यो अमृतं दुहाना आपो देवीरुभयांस्तर्पयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
putram pautramabhitarpayantirapo madhumatirimah |
svadham pitribhyo amritam duhana apo devirubhayamstarpayantu ||
verses.en: These waters, rich in honey, satisfying (abhi-tṛp) son [and] grandson, yielding to the Fathers svadhā́ [and] amṛ́ta—let the heavenly waters gratify both sides.

verses.sa:
आपो अग्निं प्र हिणुत पितॄंरुपेमं यज्ञं पितरो मे जुषन्ताम् ।
आसीनामूर्जमुप ये सचन्ते ते नो रयिं सर्ववीरं नि यछान् ॥
verses.rom:
apo agnim pra hinuta pitrimrupemam yajnam pitaro me jushantam |
asinamurjamupa ye sachante te no rayim sarvaviram ni yachhan ||
verses.en: O waters, send forth (pra-hi) Agni unto the Fathers; this sacrifice of mine let the Fathers enjoy; they who attach themselves unto a sitting refreshment, may they confirm to us wealth having all heroes.

verses.sa:
समिन्धते अमर्त्यं हव्यवाहं घृतप्रियम् ।
स वेद निहितान् निधीन् पितॄन् परावतो गतान् ॥
verses.rom:
samindhate amartyam havyavaham ghritapriyam |
sa veda nihitan nidhin pitrin paravato gatan ||
verses.en: They kindle the immortal one, oblation-carrying, ghee-loving; he knoweth the deposited deposits, the Fathers that are gone away to the distances.

verses.sa:
यं ते मन्थं यमोदनं यन् मांसं निपृणामि ते ।
ते ते सन्तु स्वधावन्तो मधुमन्तो घृतश्चुतः ॥
verses.rom:
yam te mantham yamodanam yan mamsam niprinami te |
te te santu svadhavanto madhumanto ghritashchutah ||
verses.en: What stirabout for thee, what rice-dish, what flesh I offer (ni-pṛ) to thee, be they for thee rich in svadhā́, rich in honey, dripping with ghee.

verses.sa:
यास्ते धाना अनुकिरामि तिलमिश्राः स्वधावतीः ।
तास्ते सन्तूद्भ्वीः प्रभ्वीस्तास्ते यमो राजानु मन्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yaste dhana anukirami tilamishrah svadhavatih |
taste santudbhvih prabhvistaste yamo rajanu manyatam ||
verses.en: What grains I scatter along for thee, mixed with sesame, rich in svadhā́, be they for thee abundant, prevailing; them let king Yama approve for thee.

verses.sa:
इदं पूर्वमपरं नियानं येना ते पूर्वे पितरः परेताः ।
पुरोगवा ये अभिसाचो अस्य ते त्वा वहन्ति सुकृतामु लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
idam purvamaparam niyanam yena te purve pitarah paretah |
purogava ye abhisacho asya te tva vahanti sukritamu lokam ||
verses.en: This [is] the former, the after down-track, by which thy former Fathers went away; they who are the forerunners, the followers (? abhiṣác) of it, they carry thee to the world of the well-doing.

verses.sa:
सरस्वतीं देवयन्तो हवन्ते सरस्वतीमध्वरे तायमाने ।
सरस्वतीं सुकृतो हवन्ते सरस्वती दाशुषे वार्यं दात् ॥
verses.rom:
sarasvatim devayanto havante sarasvatimadhvare tayamane |
sarasvatim sukrito havante sarasvati dashushe varyam dat ||
verses.en: On Sarasvatī do the pious call; on Sarasvatī, while the sacrifice is being extended; on Sarasvatī do the well-doers call; may Sarasvatī give what is desirable to the worshiper.

verses.sa:
सरस्वतीं पितरो हवन्ते दक्षिणा यज्ञमभिनक्षमाणाः ।
आसद्यास्मिन् बर्हिषि मादयध्वमनमीवा इष आ धेह्यस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
sarasvatim pitaro havante dakshina yajnamabhinakshamanah |
asadyasmin barhishi madayadhvamanamiva isha a dhehyasme ||
verses.en: On Sarasvatī do the Fathers call, arriving at the sacrifice on the south; sitting on this barhís, do ye revel; assign thou to us food free from disease.

verses.sa:
सरस्वति या सरथं ययाथोक्थैः स्वधाभिर्देवि पितृभिर्मदन्ती ।
सहस्रार्घमिडो अत्र भागं रायस्पोषं यजमानाय धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
sarasvati ya saratham yayathokthaih svadhabhirdevi pitribhirmadanti |
sahasrarghamido atra bhagam rayasposham yajamanaya dhehi ||
verses.en: O Sarasvatī, that wentest in company with the songs, with the svadhā́s, O goddess, reveling with the Fathers, assign thou to the sacrificer here a portion of refreshment of thousand-fold value, abundance of wealth.

verses.sa:
पृथिवीं त्वा पृथिव्यामा वेशयामि देवो नो धाता प्र तिरात्यायुः ।
परापरैता वसुविद्वो अस्त्वधा मृताः पितृषु सं भवन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
prithivim tva prithivyama veshayami devo no dhata pra tiratyayuh |
paraparaita vasuvidvo astvadha mritah pitrishu sam bhavantu ||
verses.en: Thee, being earth, I make enter into earth; may god Dhātar lengthen out our life-time; let him that goeth very far away be a finder of good for you; then may the dead (pl.) come to be (sam-bhū) among the Fathers.

verses.sa:
आ प्र च्यवेथामप तन् मृजेथां यद्वामभिभा अत्रोचुः ।
अस्मादेतमघ्न्यौ तद्वशीयो दातुः पितृष्विहभोजनौ मम ॥
verses.rom:
a pra chyavethamapa tan mrijetham yadvamabhibha atrochuh |
asmadetamaghnyau tadvashiyo datuh pitrishvihabhojanau mama ||
verses.en: Start ye (du.) forward hither, wipe off that which the portents (? abhibhā́) have said there of you; from that come ye, inviolable ones, to this which is better, being bestowers here on me, a giver to the Fathers.

verses.sa:
एयमगन् दक्षिणा भद्रतो ना अनेन दत्ता सुदुघा वयोधाः ।
यौवने जीवान् उपपृञ्चती जरा पितृभ्य उपसंपराणयादिमान् ॥
verses.rom:
eyamagan dakshina bhadrato na anena datta sudugha vayodhah |
yauvane jivan upaprinchati jara pitribhya upasamparanayadiman ||
verses.en: This sacrificial gift hath come excellently to us, given by him, well-milking, vigor-bestowing; old age, coming close to (? upa-pṛc) them living in youth, shall lead these away together unto the Fathers.

verses.sa:
इदं पितृभ्यः प्र भरामि बर्हिर्जीवं देवेभ्य उत्तरं स्तृणामि ।
तदा रोह पुरुष मेध्यो भवन् प्रति त्वा जानन्तु पितरः परेतम् ॥
verses.rom:
idam pitribhyah pra bharami barhirjivam devebhya uttaram strinami |
tada roha purusha medhyo bhavan prati tva janantu pitarah paretam ||
verses.en: This barhís I bring forward for the Fathers; a living, higher one I strew for the gods; that do thou ascend, O man, becoming sacrificial; let the Fathers acknowledge thee who art departed.

verses.sa:
एदं बर्हिरसदो मेध्योऽभूः प्रति त्वा जानन्तु पितरः परेतम् ।
यथापरु तन्वं सं भरस्व गात्राणि ते ब्रह्मणा कल्पयामि ॥
verses.rom:
edam barhirasado medhyo'bhuh prati tva janantu pitarah paretam |
yathaparu tanvam sam bharasva gatrani te brahmana kalpayami ||
verses.en: Thou hast sat upon this barhís, thou hast become sacrificial; let the Fathers acknowledge thee who art departed; collect thy body according to its joints; I arrange thy members with bráhman.

verses.sa:
पर्णो राजापिधानं चरूणामूर्जो बलं सह ओजो न आगन् ।
आयुर्जीवेभ्यो विदधद्दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय ॥
verses.rom:
parno rajapidhanam charunamurjo balam saha ojo na agan |
ayurjivebhyo vidadhaddirghayutvaya shatasharadaya ||
verses.en: King leaf is the cover of the dishes; the strength of refreshment, the power, vigor, hath come to us, dispensing (vi-dhā) life-time to the living (pl.), in order to length of life for a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जो भागो य इमं जजानाश्मान्नानामाधिपत्यं जगाम ।
तमर्चत विश्वमित्रा हविर्भिः स नो यमः प्रतरं जीवसे धात् ॥
verses.rom:
urjo bhago ya imam jajanashmannanamadhipatyam jagama |
tamarchata vishvamitra havirbhih sa no yamah prataram jivase dhat ||
verses.en: The share of refreshment that generated this man;—the stone attained (gam) the overlordship of the foods;—him praise ye, all-befriended, with oblations; may that Yama make (dhā) us to live further.

verses.sa:
यथा यमाय हर्म्यमवपन् पञ्च मानवाः ।
एवा वपामि हर्म्यं यथा मे भूरयोऽसत ॥
verses.rom:
yatha yamaya harmyamavapan pancha manavah |
eva vapami harmyam yatha me bhurayo'sata ||
verses.en: As the five clans (mānavá) scattered (vap) a dwelling (harmyá) for Yama, so do I scatter a dwelling, that there may be many of me (?).

verses.sa:
इदं हिरण्यं बिभृहि यत्ते पिताबिभः पुरा ।
स्वर्गं यतः पितुर्हस्तं निर्मृड्ढि दक्षिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
idam hiranyam bibhrihi yatte pitabibhah pura |
svargam yatah piturhastam nirmriddhi dakshinam ||
verses.en: Wear (bhṛ) thou this gold, which thy father wore before; of thy father, going to heaven (svargá), do thou wipe off the right hand.

verses.sa:
ये च जीवा ये च मृता ये जाता ये च यज्ञियाः ।
तेभ्यो घृतस्य कुल्यैतु मधुधारा व्युन्दती ॥
verses.rom:
ye cha jiva ye cha mrita ye jata ye cha yajniyah |
tebhyo ghritasya kulyaitu madhudhara vyundati ||
verses.en: Both those who are living and those who are dead; those who are born and those who are worshipful—for them let there go a brook of ghee, honey-streamed, overflowing.

verses.sa:
वृषा मतीनां पवते विचक्षणः सूरो अह्नां प्रतरीतोषसां दिवः ।
प्राणः सिन्धूनां कलशामचिक्रददिन्द्रस्य हार्दिमाविशन् मनीषया ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha matinam pavate vichakshanah suro ahnam prataritoshasam divah |
pranah sindhunam kalashamachikradadindrasya hardimavishan manishaya ||
verses.en: There purifies itself the conspicuous bull of the prayers, the sun of days, lengthener out of dawns, of the sky (dív); the breath of the rivers hath made the jars to resound loudly; entering Indra's heart with skill.

verses.sa:
त्वेषस्ते धूम ऊर्णोतु दिवि षं छुक्र आततः ।
सूरो न हि द्युता त्वं कृपा पावक रोचसे ॥
verses.rom:
tveshaste dhuma urnotu divi sham chhukra atatah |
suro na hi dyuta tvam kripa pavaka rochase ||
verses.en: Let thy sparkling (? tveṣá) smoke cover, being in the sky, extended bright; for thou, O purifier, shinest like the sun with luster, with beauty (kṛpā́).

verses.sa:
प्र वा एतीन्दुरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतिं सखा सख्युर्न प्र मिनाति संगिरः ।
मर्य इव योषाः समर्षसे सोमः कलशे शतयामना पथा ॥
verses.rom:
pra va etindurindrasya nishkritim sakha sakhyurna pra minati samgirah |
marya iva yoshah samarshase somah kalashe shatayamana patha ||
verses.en: Soma (índu) verily goes forward to Indra's rendezvous; the comrade does not violate (pra-mī) the comrade's agreements; thou rushest to join, as a male after females—soma, in the jar, by a road of a hundred tracks.

verses.sa:
अक्षन्न् अमीमदन्त ह्यव प्रियामधूषत ।
अस्तोषत स्वभानवो विप्रा यविष्ठा ईमहे ॥
verses.rom:
akshann amimadanta hyava priyamadhushata |
astoshata svabhanavo vipra yavishtha imahe ||
verses.en: They have eaten; they have revelled surely; they have shaken off (áva) those that are dear; having own brightness (svábhānu), they have praised; inspired, youngest, we implore.

verses.sa:
आ यात पितरः सोम्यासो गम्भीरैः पथिभिः पितृयाणैः ।
आयुरस्मभ्यं दधतः प्रजां च रायश्च पोषैरभि नः सचध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
a yata pitarah somyaso gambhiraih pathibhih pitriyanaih |
ayurasmabhyam dadhatah prajam cha rayashcha poshairabhi nah sachadhvam ||
verses.en: Come ye, O Fathers, delectable, by profound roads that the Fathers travel, assigning to us lifetime and progeny; and do ye attach yourselves to us with abundances of wealth.

verses.sa:
परा यात पितरः सोम्यासो गम्भीरैः पथिभिः पूर्याणैः ।
अधा मासि पुनरा यात नो गृहान् हविरत्तुं सुप्रजसः सुवीराः ॥
verses.rom:
para yata pitarah somyaso gambhiraih pathibhih puryanaih |
adha masi punara yata no grihan havirattum suprajasah suvirah ||
verses.en: Go away, O Fathers, delectable, by profound roads that go to the stronghold (pūryā́ṇa); then, in a month, come ye again to our houses to eat the oblation, with good progeny, with good heroes.

verses.sa:
यद्वो अग्निरजहादेकमङ्गं पितृलोकं गमयं जातवेदाः ।
तद्व एतत्पुनरा प्याययामि साङ्गाः स्वर्गे पितरो मादयध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadvo agnirajahadekamangam pitrilokam gamayam jatavedah |
tadva etatpunara pyayayami sangah svarge pitaro madayadhvam ||
verses.en: What one limb of you Agni Jātavedas left when making you go to the Fathers' world, that same for you I fill up again; revel ye, O Fathers, in heaven (svargá) with [all] your limbs.

verses.sa:
अभूद्दूतः प्रहितो जातवेदाः सायं न्यह्न उपवन्द्यो नृभिः ।
प्रादाः पितृभ्यः स्वधया ते अक्षन्न् अद्धि त्वं देव प्रयता हवींषि ॥
verses.rom:
abhuddutah prahito jatavedah sayam nyahna upavandyo nribhih |
pradah pitribhyah svadhaya te akshann addhi tvam deva prayata havimshi ||
verses.en: Jātavedas has been the messenger sent forth, at evening, at close of day to be honored by men;—thou hast given to the Fathers; they have eaten after their wont; eat thou, O god, the presented oblations.

verses.sa:
असौ हा इह ते मनः ककुत्सलमिव जामयः ।
अभ्येनं भूम ऊर्णुहि ॥
verses.rom:
asau ha iha te manah kakutsalamiva jamayah |
abhyenam bhuma urnuhi ||
verses.en: Thou yonder, ho! hither thy mind! as sisters (jāmí) a kákutsala, do thou cover him, O earth.

verses.sa: शुम्भन्तां लोकाः पितृषदनाः पितृषदने त्वा लोक आ सादयामि ॥
verses.rom: shumbhantam lokah pitrishadanah pitrishadane tva loka a sadayami ||
verses.en: Let the worlds where the Fathers sit adorn themselves (çumbh); I make thee to sit in the world where the Fathers sit.

verses.sa: ये अस्माकं पितरस्तेषां बर्हिरसि ॥
verses.rom: ye asmakam pitarastesham barhirasi ||
verses.en: Thou art the barhís of them that are our Fathers.

verses.sa:
उदुत्तमं वरुण पाशमस्मदवाधमं श्रथाय ।
अधा वयमादित्य व्रते तवानागसो अदितये स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
uduttamam varuna pashamasmadavadhamam shrathaya |
adha vayamaditya vrate tavanagaso aditaye syama ||
verses.en: Loosen up the uppermost fetter from us, O Varuṇa, [loosen] down the lowest, off the midmost; then may we in thy sphere, O Āditya, be guiltless unto Aditi.

verses.sa:
प्रास्मत्पाशान् वरुण मुञ्च सर्वान् यैः समामे बध्यते यैर्व्यामे ।
अधा जीवेम शरदं शतानि त्वया राजन् गुपिता रक्षमाणाः ॥
verses.rom:
prasmatpashan varuna muncha sarvan yaih samame badhyate yairvyame |
adha jivema sharadam shatani tvaya rajan gupita rakshamanah ||
verses.en: Release from us all fetters, O Varuṇa, with which one is bound crosswise, with which lengthwise; so may we live hundreds of autumns, by thee, O king, guarded, defended.

verses.sa: अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्वधा नमः ॥
verses.rom: agnaye kavyavahanaya svadha namah ||
verses.en: To Agni, carrier of the kavyás, [be] svadhā́ [and] homage.

verses.sa: सोमाय पितृमते स्वधा नमः ॥
verses.rom: somaya pitrimate svadha namah ||
verses.en: To Soma with the Fathers [be] svadhā́ [and] homage.

verses.sa: पितृभ्यः सोमवद्भ्यः स्वधा नमः ॥
verses.rom: pitribhyah somavadbhyah svadha namah ||
verses.en: To the Fathers with Soma, svadhā́ [and] homage.

verses.sa: यमाय पितृमते स्वधा नमः ॥
verses.rom: yamaya pitrimate svadha namah ||
verses.en: To Yama with the Fathers, svadhā́ [and] homage.

verses.sa: एतत्ते प्रततामह स्वधा ये च त्वामनु ॥
verses.rom: etatte pratatamaha svadha ye cha tvamanu ||
verses.en: Here is svadhā́ for thee, O great-grandfather, and for them that are after (ánu) thee.

verses.sa: एतत्ते ततामह स्वधा ये च त्वामनु ॥
verses.rom: etatte tatamaha svadha ye cha tvamanu ||
verses.en: Here is svadhā́ for thee, O grandfather, and for them that are after thee.

verses.sa: एतत्ते तत स्वधा ॥
verses.rom: etatte tata svadha ||
verses.en: Here is svadhā́ for thee, O father.

verses.sa: स्वधा पितृभ्यः पृथिविषद्भ्यः ॥
verses.rom: svadha pitribhyah prithivishadbhyah ||
verses.en: Svadhā́ to the Fathers that sit upon the earth.

verses.sa: स्वधा पितृभ्यो अन्तरिक्षसद्भ्यः ॥
verses.rom: svadha pitribhyo antarikshasadbhyah ||
verses.en: Svadhā́ to the Fathers that sit in the atmosphere.

verses.sa: स्वधा पितृभ्यो दिविषद्भ्यः ॥
verses.rom: svadha pitribhyo divishadbhyah ||
verses.en: Svadhā́ to the Fathers that sit in the sky (dív).

verses.sa: नमो वः पितर ऊर्जे नमो वः पितरो रसाय ॥
verses.rom: namo vah pitara urje namo vah pitaro rasaya ||
verses.en: Homage, O Fathers, to your refreshment (ū́rj); homage, O Fathers, to your sap.

verses.sa: नमो वः पितरो भामाय नमो वः पितरो मन्यवे ॥
verses.rom: namo vah pitaro bhamaya namo vah pitaro manyave ||
verses.en: Homage, O Fathers, to your terror* (bhā́ma); homage, O Fathers, to your fury.

verses.sa: नमो वः पितरो यद्घोरं तस्मै नमो वः पितरो यत्क्रूरं तस्मै ॥
verses.rom: namo vah pitaro yadghoram tasmai namo vah pitaro yatkruram tasmai ||
verses.en: Homage, O Fathers, to that of yours which is terrible; homage, O Fathers, to that of yours which is cruel.

verses.sa: नमो वः पितरो यच्छिवं तस्मै नमो वः पितरो यत्स्योनं तस्मै ॥
verses.rom: namo vah pitaro yachchhivam tasmai namo vah pitaro yatsyonam tasmai ||
verses.en: Homage, O Fathers, to that of yours which is propitious; homage, O Fathers, to that of yours which is pleasant.

verses.sa: नमो वः पितरः स्वधा वः पितरः ॥
verses.rom: namo vah pitarah svadha vah pitarah ||
verses.en: Homage to you, O Fathers; svadhā́ to you, O Fathers.

verses.sa: येऽत्र पितरः पितरो येऽत्र यूयं स्थ युष्मांस्तेऽनु यूयं तेषां श्रेष्ठा भूयास्थ ॥
verses.rom: ye'tra pitarah pitaro ye'tra yuyam stha yushmamste'nu yuyam tesham shreshtha bhuyastha ||
verses.en: They who are there, O Fathers—Fathers there are ye—[be] they after you; may ye be the best of them.

verses.sa:
य इह पितरो जीवा इह वयं स्मः ।
अस्मांस्तेऽनु वयं तेषां श्रेष्ठा भूयास्म ॥
verses.rom:
ya iha pitaro jiva iha vayam smah |
asmamste'nu vayam tesham shreshtha bhuyasma ||
verses.en: They who are here, O Fathers—alive here are we—[be] they after us; may we be the best of them.

verses.sa:
आ त्वाग्न इधीमहि द्युमन्तं देवाजरम् ।
यद्घ सा ते पनीयसी समिद्दीदयति द्यवि ।
इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
a tvagna idhimahi dyumantam devajaram |
yadgha sa te paniyasi samiddidayati dyavi |
isham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en: Thee, O Agni, would we kindle, full of light (dyumánt), O god, unwasting; as that very wondrous fuel of thine shall shine in the sky (dív), bring thou food for thy praisers.

verses.sa:
चन्द्रमा अप्स्वन्तरा सुपर्णो धावते दिवि ।
न वो हिरण्यनेमयः पदं विन्दन्ति विद्युतो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
chandrama apsvantara suparno dhavate divi |
na vo hiranyanemayah padam vindanti vidyuto vittam me asya rodasi ||
verses.en: The moon among the waters runs, an eagle in the sky (dív); they find not your track, O golden-rimmed lightnings: know me as such, O firmaments (ródasī).
